8.name: A Rogue's Deal
desc: Deliver the Nondescript Letter to Innkeeper Renee in Tirisfal Glades.
objectives: Deliver the Nondescript Letter to Innkeeper Renee in Tirisfal Glades.
details: Hey, mate! Do a favor for a young man who's been fighting more than his fair share of mindless zombies and spiders?
BI got this here letter that needs to go to Brill... to an innkeeper named Renee something-or-other. Don't really matter none what her last name is.

BAnyway, it's a nice cozy little place full of victims of the plague trying to make their way in the world. And it be a great spot for you to rest too if the need arises. You should check it out... you do and I'll pay you well.
completion: Oh? A letter? Wonderful news! I've been waiting on word from my dear old mother in Deathknell. Such a saint, she is. I wonder how she's holding up.
BWhat? Too cheery? Not buying it, are you?
BWell, get lost then... it's really no business who the letter's from anyway. Go on! Get lost!
BCome back when you've got some coin to spend... loafer.
BNext thing you know, you'll be coming back to rest after a long days adventure or some stupid thing like that.

32.name: Rise of the Silithid
desc: Take the report to Zilzibin Drumlore in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Take the report to Zilzibin Drumlore in Orgrimmar.
details: Here's your report. I urge you to take it to someone who might have working knowledge in this kind of thing.

BI know this troll scholar named Zilzibin Drumlore. He's spent a lot of time studying life forms that are unique to the ecology of Azeroth; he's a historian to boot! If you want someone to help figure out what exactly this threat is and how to stop it, give this report to him. We're going to need all the help we can get.
BZil lives in a house on the second tier of the Drag in Orgrimmar.
completion: This report... I've dealt with these beasts before. Fizzledowser was wise to send this. and you, to me.

BThese creatures will consume the Tanaris desert rapidly; they are nothing short of one of the greatest menaces we all will ever face. Familiarize yourself with this name, $N: silithid. The insects mentioned here are the silithid, and they are the tools of one of the greatest threats that both the Horde and Alliance face.
BIf only we were smart enough to see that before.

56.name: The Night Watch
desc: Commander Althea Ebonlocke of Darkshire wants you to kill 8 Skeletal Warriors and 6 Skeletal Mages.
objectives: Commander Althea Ebonlocke of Darkshire wants you to kill 8 Skeletal Warriors and 6 Skeletal Mages.
details: As Commander of The Night Watch it is my sworn duty to protect the citizens of Darkshire. Stormwind has retracted their commissioned guards from their posts here, leaving us to our own devices.

BIf you feel worthy of the task, we need your help! Assist The Night Watch by venturing forth into Tranquil Gardens, just south of Darkshire, and slaying 8 Skeletal Warriors and 6 Skeletal Mages. The undead threat must be thwarted!
completion: Splendid, $N. For your service to the people of Darkshire you shall be rewarded.

80.name: The Legend of Stalvan
desc: Show Clerk Daltry the Bloodstained Journal Page.
objectives: Show Clerk Daltry the Bloodstained Journal Page.
details: I have had my eye on that creep, Stalvan, for quite sometime. But if this page was written by the same hand it proves his guilt beyond a shadow of a doubt.
BIn all his days keeping the Town Registry, Clerk Daltry has become an expert at identifying handwriting. Show him this page and see if the writing matches that of the registry signature.
completion: Why yes! The writing on this page does in fact match that of the registry signatures.

104.name: The Coastal Menace
desc: Bring a scale of Old Murk-Eye to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.
objectives: Bring a scale of Old Murk-Eye to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.
details: When my life was ended upon the rocks, I had no clue what the afterlife held for me. The Lighthouse was black that night because Old Murk-Eye had scared the keeper's family off. They returned and re-lit the flame but Old Murk-Eye coerced the weaker minded murlocs to raid the Lighthouse with him once again. The second time the family was not so lucky and before my eyes they perished helplessly.
BSlay Old Murk-Eye if you see him along the shore and bring me one of his scales and I shall reward you.
completion: So the foul heathen, Murk-Eye is dead. Well done, $N. By your hands one life was laid to rest but perhaps many more were saved. The Great Sea, wrought with danger as it is, shall be a wee bit safer this night thanks to your heroics.

128.name: Blackrock Bounty
desc: Kill 15 Blackrock Champions and Guard Howe in Lakeshire will reward you.
objectives: Kill 15 Blackrock Champions and Guard Howe in Lakeshire will reward you.
details: The Blackrock Clan must be destroyed. The Enemy has invaded our lands. These mountains fall under the sovereign right of the King of Stormwind. Our sources tell us that the leaders of each unit within the Clan are known as Champions. You'll find them in their encampment to the north, just west of the road to the Burning Steppes.
BMagistrate Solomon wants these foul brutes dead. Slay 15 Blackrock Champions and return to me.
completion: I see you have fought valiantly against the Blackrock Clan, $C. Your service to our township is great indeed.

152.name: The Coast Isn't Clear
desc: Kill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and return to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.
objectives: Kill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and return to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.
details: You probably noticed all of the shipwrecks along the coast. The Great Sea is treacherous indeed. The coast of Westfall needs to be kept clear, so that if sailors find their way to our beaches, they are safe. The Murlocs are trouble though.
BKill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and I will see to it that you are rewarded.
completion: Well done, $N. You have quite a knack for combat. Thanks to you the Coast of Westfall is a safer place.

176.name: Wanted:  "Hogger"
desc: Slay the gnoll Hogger and bring his Huge Gnoll Claw to Marshal Dughan.
objectives: Slay the gnoll Hogger and bring his Huge Gnoll Claw to Marshal Dughan.
details: Wanted: Hogger
BA huge gnoll, Hogger, is prowling the woods in southwestern Elwynn. He has overpowered all attempts at his capture.
BThe Stormwind Army has placed a generous bounty on the Gnoll. To earn the reward, bounty hunters should bring proof of Hogger's demise to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
completion: Hah! Well done! I was starting to think no one would take down that monster!
BHere you are, $N. And thanks - that Gnoll was giving me a headache the size of Blackrock Spire!

200.name: Bookie Herod
desc: Find Bookie Herod's Records.
objectives: Find Bookie Herod's Records.
details: If Kurzen knows Thorsen's secret, then we have a spy in our midst. We must determine how the secret was leaked!

BThorsen's contact within Kurzen's camp was Bookie Herod. Herod is Kurzen's logistics officer and knows everything about the running of Kurzen's Compound. If you can get Herod's notes or records, maybe we can find out how Thorsen was discovered.
BWhen we were still with Kurzen, Bookie's office was on the top floor of the camp's only two-story house. His records are probably still there.
completion: These are Bookie Herod's notes and records.
BAmong them are: a list of supplies within the camp, material requests from Colonel Kurzen, and various letters and correspondences.

224.name: In Defense of the King's Lands
desc: Mountaineer Cobbleflint of the southern guard tower wants you to kill 10 Stonesplinter Troggs and 10 Stonesplinter Scouts.
objectives: Mountaineer Cobbleflint of the southern guard tower wants you to kill 10 Stonesplinter Troggs and 10 Stonesplinter Scouts.
details: We need to protect the Loch, $N! With so many of the King's soldiers fighting valiantly on remote battlefields, we've become overwhelmed on the home front. Troggs are tunneling up from every crevice! The Trogg infestation poses the largest threat to Ironforge. These disgusting mutants must be destroyed.
BWe need you, brave adventurer, to venture forth and lay waste to the Trogg threat. Slay 10 Stonesplinter Troggs and 10 Stonesplinter Scouts and report back.
completion: Well done, $N! You demonstrated uncanny courage on the battlefield. Our war against the Troggs will be won with efforts such as yours. You have served King Magni well.

BIf you fancy yourself well-suited for this kind of adventuring, I suggest you speak with Mountaineer Gravelgaw. The Captain has him assigned to a rough patrol that I am sure he can use some help with. Check with Gravelgaw just inside the tower.

248.name: Looking Further
desc: Climb the intact watch tower beside Stonewatch Keep.
Find a suitable container to place the Glyph of Azora.
objectives: Climb the intact watch tower beside Stonewatch Keep.
BFind a suitable container to place the Glyph of Azora.
details: I have been watching the Tower of Ilgalar, and can detect that Morganth is in conflict with the Orcs in Stonewatch Keep. I do not know the reason behind their contention, but you may aid me in unraveling this mystery.
BTake another Glyph of Azora, then go to the top of the intact watch tower beside Stonewatch Keep.
BFind a suitable object on which to place the Glyph. A chest or a jar -- some place where the glyph will not be noticed -- will suit my purpose.
completion: It is a suitable vessel for the Glyph of Azora, allowing Theocritus to delve into the minds within Stonewatch Keep.

272.name: Trial of the Sea Lion
desc: Find the Half Pendant of Aquatic Agility and the Half Pendant of Aquatic Endurance. Speak with the residents of Moonglade to learn clues as to where these items may be located.
Form the Pendant of the Sea Lion from the two pendant halves. You need to be in proximity of the Shrine of Remulos to do this.
Bring the joined pendant to Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
objectives: Find the Half Pendant of Aquatic Agility and the Half Pendant of Aquatic Endurance. Speak with the residents of Moonglade to learn clues as to where these items may be located.
BForm the Pendant of the Sea Lion from the two pendant halves. You need to be in proximity of the Shrine of Remulos to do this.
BBring the joined pendant to Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
details: For the second trial, you'll need the two halves that make the Pendant of the Sea Lion. One half draws power from the agility of the sea lion aspect, gliding through water; the other draws power from the incredible endurance of the sea lion aspect. Druids draw on both these traits equally to embody the aspect of their aquatic form.
BSpeak with the locals of Moonglade to learn where the parts may lie, and bring both here to join them together. Once formed, take the pendant to Dendrite Starblaze.
completion: You've completed the Trial of the Sea Lion, $N - congratulations.

BEach task in acquiring the pendant shows that both agility and endurance are necessary to act in harmony with what you desire to do underwater. Neither can exist without the other, and both cannot be done without your willingness to embrace the aspect of the sea lion.
BRemember these lessons well, and count on them once you have gained your aquatic form.

296.name: Ormer's Revenge
desc: Ormer Ironbraid at the Whelgar Excavation Site wants you to kill Sarltooth and return to him with one of his talons once the task is fulfilled.
objectives: Ormer Ironbraid at the Whelgar Excavation Site wants you to kill Sarltooth and return to him with one of his talons once the task is fulfilled.
details: While you were down there I happened to notice that one of those beasts stood out from the rest. He was bigger and more menacing. I bet he's the one who led the others here to cause the disruption to the dig site.

BI ask of you now one final task, $N. See to it that Sarltooth is brought to justice. And considering the gravity of his crimes, justice in this case means death! Bring me one of his talons as proof of his death.
completion: Thank you, $N. Your efforts here will not be forgotten. Many innocent Dwarves died at this site, simply doing their jobs. The vengeance you delivered to those evil creatures should make them think twice before attacking King Magni's subjects ever again.

320.name: Return to Bellowfiz
desc: Give the cask of Evershine to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot.
objectives: Give the cask of Evershine to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot.
details: Here's your cask of Evershine, $N. And again, thank you for the hunting earlier.
completion: Yes, this will do just fine. I think I'll open a bottle right now and have a taste...

344.name: Brother Paxton
desc: Speak with Brother Paxton in the Northshire Abbey.
objectives: Speak with Brother Paxton in the Northshire Abbey.
details: The Stresses of Iron? Yes, I know the book. Quite a good one, written by the Dwarven miner Margulf Blaggon a few decades ago. He spent most his time deep in the mountains of Khaz Modan, digging ore. Smart fellow!

BBut where was I? Oh yes, the Stresses of Iron! I'm afraid the book was moved to the Northshire Abbey. The caretaker of the Abbey's library, Brother Paxton, wanted to make a copy of the book for his own shelves.
BBut that was months ago. I wonder why it's taking him so long...
completion: Mr. Sheaf is wondering where his book is? Well this is a tad embarrassing. I have the book, but I'm still making my copy and I'm not quite ready to give the original up!

368.name: A New Plague
desc: Apothecary Johaan of the town of Brill needs 5 Vile Fin Scales from Murlocs in Tirisfal Glades.
objectives: Apothecary Johaan of the town of Brill needs 5 Vile Fin Scales from Murlocs in Tirisfal Glades.
details: While you were collecting samples for me, my experiments led me to realize that more reagents will be required for this new disease to spread properly. Poisoning some hapless victim is child's play. Plaguing an entire world proves to be a bit more complicated.
BI will need 5 Vile Fin Scales from Murlocs in the vicinity. You will find the creatures along the coast to the north or to the west.
completion: The scales are perfect, $N. Exactly what I needed for this concoction.

392.name: The Curious Visitor
desc: Bring the Sealed Description of Thredd's Visitor to Baros Alexston in Stormwind.
objectives: Bring the Sealed Description of Thredd's Visitor to Baros Alexston in Stormwind.
details: During the first years of Thredd's imprisonment, he never had any visitors. I figured that he was no longer of use to the Brotherhood, so they abandoned him.
BAnyway, a few months ago, that all changed; he started to get regular visits... once, maybe twice a week. It was a strange man--the quiet type. I had my suspicions, but all his papers checked out.
BHis documents claimed his name was Maelik; here's his description. I don't think he'll be coming to visit Thredd anymore.
completion: Hmm. Maelik? No, the name doesn't sound familiar and neither does this description. But it could be anybody! A former Stonemason, one of the Defias Brotherhood... Though if he is as well connected as Thelwater suggests, perhaps someone else might recognize him. Let me think.

416.name: Rat Catching
desc: Bring 12 Tunnel Rat Ears to Mountaineer Kadrell in Thelsamar.
objectives: Bring 12 Tunnel Rat Ears to Mountaineer Kadrell in Thelsamar.
details: We have a real infestation problem to the west. Tunnel rat kobolds have moved into the foothills, setting up dens and fouling our land with their filth!
BWe want them eliminated. Hunt them, bring me their ears and earn their bounty.
BYou can find tunnel rat kobolds and their dens west of Thelsamar, littered along the mountainside.
completion: Ugh! When I asked for those ears I didn't realize they'd smell so bad!
BHere's your reward, $N. Well done.

440.name: The Engraved Ring
desc: Bring Deliah's Ring to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.
objectives: Bring Deliah's Ring to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.
details: If you want to find the husband or beloved who gave Deliah her ring... then speak with Magistrate Sevren in Brill. He should have records of recent deaths and, with luck, can discover who Deliah is.
BBut I wouldn't hope. Whoever gave her the ring is probably dead. Or if he's undead he probably no longer cares about Deliah.
completion: A Deliah did live in Brill not long ago. She was buried in the mass grave but if what you say is true, then the Rot Hide Gnolls must have stolen her body and taken it to Silverpine.
BThe Rot Hides, like all the Scourge, must be destroyed. I trust you are taking steps to make that happen.

464.name: War Banners
desc: Bring 8 Dragonmaw War Banners to Captain Stoutfist.
objectives: Bring 8 Dragonmaw War Banners to Captain Stoutfist.
details: The Dragonmaw orc clan was all but destroyed by the end of the Second War, after they lost control of their red dragon pets. The dragons were not very happy with their old masters, and fiercely hunted the Dragonmaws. What few remained fled from Grim Batol and into the Mountains east of Whelgar's Excavation.
BNow they've gained strength, and have an encampment northeast of Menethil.
BWe want you to attack that encampment. Gather and bring me their war banners as proof.
completion: Well fought, $N. The Dragonmaws are not the same threat they were when they had dragons, but they're still fierce opponents.

BThe Dragonmaws are led by Nek'rosh, son of Nekros, who was the former head of the Dragonmaws years ago. Nekros used powerful magic to tame the Red Dragons, but when that magic failed him...the dragons were not happy.
BNekros was killed, and his son has vowed revenge against the dragons who slew his father.

488.name: Zenn's Bidding
desc: Bring Zenn Foulhoof outside of Dolanaar 3 Nightsaber Fangs, 3 Strigid Owl Feathers and 3 swatches of Webwood Spider Silk.
objectives: Bring Zenn Foulhoof outside of Dolanaar 3 Nightsaber Fangs, 3 Strigid Owl Feathers and 3 swatches of Webwood Spider Silk.
details: Eager for work, I see. Lucky for you a day never goes by that I don't wish I had a fledgling $c to perform my bidding.
BYou see, $N, I can make you very happy and provide you with things you never dreamed of having. But in order for that to happen you must bring me certain items.
BMy business in the forest often requires certain. . .reagents. Fetch for me 3 Nightsaber Fangs, 3 Strigid Owl Feathers and 3 swatches of Webwood Spider Silk.
BLet's keep this our little secret, $r.
completion: Ha ha! Well, done indeed.
BWho would have ever guessed that I, Zenn Foulhoof, would have a $R to do my bidding? Certainly not me! But so it goes... this beloved world of ours is full of surprises.
BThree cheers for the naive and gullible!

512.name: Noble Deaths
desc: Bring 7 Alterac Signet Rings to Magistrate Maleb in Southshore.
objectives: Bring 7 Alterac Signet Rings to Magistrate Maleb in Southshore.
details: I fear the leadership behind the Syndicate is bent on Southshore's ruin. We must strike hard at these leaders before their plans are realized.
BEnter the ruins of Strahnbrad, in the Alterac Mountains to the north. We think the Syndicate is using the area as a headquarters.
BWe know this gang of cutthroats is run by former Alterac nobles. They may be hiding as normal Syndicate agents, but you'll know you've killed a noble by the signet ring he wears.
BBring me those signet rings.
completion: Stripping the Syndicate of its nobility will remove its ability to act decisively, and reduce it to nothing more than a gang of thugs.
BYou serve your Alliance well, $N.

536.name: Down the Coast
desc: Kill 10 Torn Fin Tidehunters and 10 Torn Fin Oracles for Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in Southshore.
objectives: Kill 10 Torn Fin Tidehunters and 10 Torn Fin Oracles for Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in Southshore.
details: Transferred from the Stormwind city guard to Southshore, a town that should be abandoned by the looks of it... Smell of the harbor day and night.
BNot to mention ol' Redpath... Wants me to take care of the murlocs. Ha!
BI can barely rouse myself to go out to some of the pockets of the overgrown fish down the Western Strand. If you would go in my place and take care of them, I'd appreciate it.
completion: I hope this will be enough to convince Redpath that I've--ha!--been carrying out his orders and ridding Southshore of the terrible and horrible menace of the dreaded murlocs! For there could be no greater evil than the ravages of overgrown fish!

560.name: Farren's Proof
desc: Deliver the sack of murloc heads to Marshall Redpath in Southshore.
objectives: Deliver the sack of murloc heads to Marshall Redpath in Southshore.
details: You know, $n, I'd really rather not take these heads... Since you've already got a handle on them, would you mind delivering them to Redpath for me?
completion: Farren's errand boy, are you?
BIf you assisted Farren in procuring these heads, then thank you. Southshore needs hard workers and effort to maintain its protection.

584.name: Bloodscalp Clan Heads
desc: Bring Gan'zulah's Head and Nezzliok's Head to the bubbling cauldron at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
objectives: Bring Gan'zulah's Head and Nezzliok's Head to the bubbling cauldron at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
details: Yenniku was not among the heads, and I thank the Great Serpent for it. But we are no closer to finding him.

BWe must know the truth, and I fear that only the Bloodscalp chief and his witchdoctor know it. They are the enemies of the Darkspear tribe and will not speak freely, so we must force the truth from their dead lips!
BBring me the heads of Gan'zulah and Nezzliok the Dire and place them within this cauldron.
BThey are deep within Zul'Kunda. Bring their heads...we will then make them talk.
completion: You place the heads of Gan'zulah and Nezzliok within the cauldron...

608.name: The Bloodsail Buccaneers
desc: Fleet-Master Seahorn in Booty Bay wants you to kill Captain Stillwater, Captain Keelhaul and Fleet Master Firallon.
objectives: Fleet-Master Seahorn in Booty Bay wants you to kill Captain Stillwater, Captain Keelhaul and Fleet Master Firallon.
details: Blast the nerve of Firallon! He couldn't sail a skiff through Crystal Lake let alone lead an entire fleet against us.
BThe Bloodsail Buccaneers will pay for their carelessness. Now that we know their plan of attack, we can counter before they know what hit them.

BBut why send the entire fleet to do the work of one brave adventuring party? $n, take some of your most skilled comrades out to Firallon's landing spot and assassinate the Bloodsail leadership. Their fleet will sink soon after....
completion: Ah, what a great day for the Blackwater Raiders! Three cheers to you, $N!

632.name: The Thandol Span
desc: Report back to Rhag Garmason and show him the parchment you found on Rustlocke's corpse.
objectives: Report back to Rhag Garmason and show him the parchment you found on Rustlocke's corpse.
details: It seems as though poor Ol' Rustlocke ran into a Dark Iron ambush. You notice a parchment next to his clenched fist.
BReport the grim news to Rhag Garmason and show him what you found.
completion: Oh my, the news is grave....

656.name: Summoning the Princess
desc: Go to the Shards of Myzrael, summon her and defeat her.
Gather her Eldritch Shackles and bind them to the Shards of Myzrael.
objectives: Go to the Shards of Myzrael, summon her and defeat her.
BGather her Eldritch Shackles and bind them to the Shards of Myzrael.
details: You must defeat Myzrael before she grows in strength. If you do not, then once she has gathered enough power she will challenge her captors! There are some who think they can control her, but if she can be controlled then why did the giants chain her in the first place??
BCrazy logic, eh?
BTo defeat her, summon her at the Shards of Myzrael where you first spoke with her. Defeat her and gather her Eldritch Shackles, then bind them to the Shards of Myzrael.
BDo that, and she will again be trapped.
completion: As the eldritch shackles are placed around the Shards, an unhuman wail is heard from far below. The scream is followed by a roar.
BThe Shards of Myzrael no longer invoke feelings of warmth and security as they once did. Now they pulse with an open menace... as if the thing beneath them holds ill will toward the surface.

680.name: The Real Threat
desc: Slay Or'Kalar and bring his Head to Korin Fel in the Hammerfall outpost.
objectives: Slay Or'Kalar and bring his Head to Korin Fel in the Hammerfall outpost.
details: You serve my husband well, $c, but he does not know why Hammerfall is under attack.
BOr'Kalar, Mug'thol's pawn in Stromgarde, has an intense hatred for my husband, and wishes nothing more than my husband's death for defeating him years ago.
BMy auguries tell me that Or'Kalar has laid a trap for my husband, so I have hidden signs of the ogre's presence from him.
BMy husband will rush off foolishly if he learns of the ogre's whereabouts and I would ask for your help in slaying the creature.
completion: You have done me a great service, $N. Know that my husband's life and the safety of Hammerfall has been protected for another day because of your deeds. Please take this as a reward for your courage.

704.name: Agmond's Fate
desc: Bring 4 Carved Stone Urns to Prospector Ironband in Loch Modan.
objectives: Bring 4 Carved Stone Urns to Prospector Ironband in Loch Modan.
details: The last report I received from Agmond is troubling, more so now that he's dead! He mentioned that his diggers uncovered "ancient urns" at the dig site outside Uldaman. I fear that the urns he found at that site incited the troggs, just as did the idols I found here.
BI need you to get those urns for our studies. Go to the Uldaman site, gather the urns, then return to me.
completion: Well done! With luck and diligence, we will find whatever link exists between the troggs and these ancient artifacts.
BYou have done a great deed for the Prospectors, $N. Your efforts will not be forgotten. And neither will Agmond.

728.name: To the Undercity for Yagyin's Digest
desc: Bring the Sigil of the Hammer to Keeper Bel'dugur in the Undercity.
objectives: Bring the Sigil of the Hammer to Keeper Bel'dugur in the Undercity.
details: The tablet tells much. But not enough! Not nearly enough!

BThere is a book, a digest that Yagyin wrote in ages past. The... people I fled from... they keep this book in many places. And their most learned study it. It holds vast knowledge. Knowledge to protect us!
BGo to Keeper Bel'dugur in the Undercity of Lordaeron. Show him this sigil and he'll think you one of them. Ask him for Yagin's Digest...and bring it to me!
completion: Be discrete with your signs, $C. There are those who do not believe the righteousness of our pledge.
BAnd there are those who would see us fail if they knew of us.
BWe must always be careful. And watchful. And patient.

752.name: A Humble Task
desc: Chief Hawkwind wants you to search for his mother near the water well to the southeast of Camp Narache.
objectives: Chief Hawkwind wants you to search for his mother near the water well to the southeast of Camp Narache.
details: All members of the tribe share in the harmony of life. We live together and work together.
BOur commitment to one another carries with it a high degree of responsibility. I ask of you now a humble task.
BMy mother set out this morning to fetch water from the well to the southeast of Narache. It has been quite some time now. Perhaps you could check on her for me while I attend to tribal matters here?
completion: You traveled all this way just to help an old woman? My my, aren't you a keeper?

776.name: Rites of the Earthmother
desc: Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff wants you to bring him the Horn of Arra'chea.
objectives: Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff wants you to bring him the Horn of Arra'chea.
details: You have passed the Rites of the Earthmother and earned your place in Thunder Bluff.
BBut in order to maintain the spot that you strived so hard to achieve, you must continue to prove your worth to your people.
BWe are hunters, $n. Down below in Mulgore there is a mighty kodo named Arra'chea. Show me your skills in the ways of tracking and hunting by bringing me the Horn of Arra'chea.
completion: Well done! A fine kill that was.
BI will send a gathering party to collect the carcass so we can retrieve the hide and meat.
BYou have done a great deed for your people, $N.

824.name: Je'neu of the Earthen Ring
desc: Bring the Befouled Water Globe to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.
objectives: Bring the Befouled Water Globe to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.
details: The Earthen Ring is a shamanistic group dedicated to studying and preserving the elements. They have forgotten more about crazy old gods, ancient legends and lore than most scholars will ever know.

BLucky for you, I know someone in the Earthen Ring here in Ashenvale. Head over to Zoram'gar Outpost on the coast of the Zoram Strand; show Je'neu Sancrea what you found. If anyone can figure out that globe's significance, it'd be him.
completion: This globe... it is most disturbing. Many of the more powerful elementals receive their power and energy through such devices. To find one like this nearly intact is one thing - to find it so tainted is another.

BI will see that this globe is studied properly by the Earthen Ring. Perhaps we can bring an end to this corruption of the elements. Please - accept this as a fair exchange for bringing this globe to the attention of the Earthen Ring.

848.name: Fungal Spores
desc: Bring 4 Fungal Spores to Apothecary Helbrim at the Crossroads.
objectives: Bring 4 Fungal Spores to Apothecary Helbrim at the Crossroads.
details: The oases of the Barrens hide a mystery. Life energy flows from their waters, invigorating the plants and beasts that drink it.
BInvigorating, and altering.
BThere is a mushroom that grows near these oases. Its spores hold properties that we, the apothecaries of Lordaeron, find useful.
BBring me these spores and you will earn our gratitude.
completion: Ah, yes. These are good specimens. Potent.
BI am Forsaken, and we honor our contracts. Here is your reward, $N.

872.name: The Disruption Ends
desc: Kill 8 Razormane Geomancers, 8 Razormane Defenders, and Kreenig Snarlsnout.
Then bring Kreenig Snarlsnout's Tusk to Thork at the Crossroads.
objectives: Kill 8 Razormane Geomancers, 8 Razormane Defenders, and Kreenig Snarlsnout.
BThen bring Kreenig Snarlsnout's Tusk to Thork at the Crossroads.
details: One of my scouts witnessed an attack on a caravan from Durotar, $N. The culprits are indeed the Razormane tribe of quilboars. One of the quilboars in particular is leading the raids: Kreenig Snarlsnout. He was seen northeast of here, just south of the road from Durotar. If the threat is to be ended, then Kreenig must die.
BTo be sure the attacks cease, though, I say we add insult to their injury. Kill Kreenig along with more of their tribe, and return to me when you have his tusk.
completion: Well done, $N. With Kreenig's death, there will be a definite decline in the attacks on our caravans.
BYour people should be proud to count you among them.

896.name: Miner's Fortune
desc: Retrieve the Cats Eye Emerald from one of the Venture Co. Overseers or Enforcers for Wharfmaster Dizzywig at Ratchet.
objectives: Retrieve the Cats Eye Emerald from one of the Venture Co. Overseers or Enforcers for Wharfmaster Dizzywig at Ratchet.
details: Being Wharfmaster of a busy port like Ratchet, I keep my finger on the pulse of information. I know all about the exchange of goods and money between here and Booty Bay.

BThe latest bit of news I've heard is about the Venture Company's Boulder Lode mine northeast of the Sludge Fen. One of the miners discovered an emerald the size of your fist. I know a few buyers who'd be interested in getting their hands on something like that, and I'd be willing to go half and half on its sale.
completion: Look at the size of that thing, $N! We're going to be rich! Let's see, according to the rates I've seen on gems going into Undermine, I should be able to figure out your cut--fifty percent, don't worry!
BNow let's see... I think this should do about right. Pleasure doing business with you, $N.

920.name: Tenaron's Summons
desc: Speak with Tenaron Stormgrip atop Aldrassil in Shadowglen.
objectives: Speak with Tenaron Stormgrip atop Aldrassil in Shadowglen.
details: $n, is it? I heard that Tenaron has been asking for you. You'll find him in the highest room atop Aldrassil.
BWe may live long lives, but it's best you not keep him waiting too long.
completion: Ah, $N. I was hoping you'd be prompt in answering my summons. I have an important task that I would like you to perform.

944.name: The Master's Glaive
desc: Gather information, then use the Phial of Scrying to create a Scrying Bowl. Use the bowl to speak with Onu.
objectives: Gather information, then use the Phial of Scrying to create a Scrying Bowl. Use the bowl to speak with Onu.
details: It is strange that the naga are here, in Darkshore. But stranger still...are the Twilight's Hammer. That cult worships the old, old lords of the earth. Lords defeated long ago.
BThe Master's Glaive, to the south, is a place where such an old lord fell.
BGo there and look for more Twilight's Hammer cultists.
BTake this phial of scrying. Use it to create a scrying bowl after searching the Master's Glaive. Then speak to me through the bowl.
completion: The Twilight's Hammer is at the Master's Glaive?
BUnfortunate.
BThe old lord impaled by the glaive is long dead, but that does not mean slivers of his power do not still remain.
BThe Twilight's Hammer must be seeking this power.

968.name: The Powers Below
desc: Bring the Book: The Powers Below to Gerrig Bonegrip in the Forlorn Cavern, Ironforge.
objectives: Bring the Book: The Powers Below to Gerrig Bonegrip in the Forlorn Cavern, Ironforge.
details: Although terribly worn and scratched, the title of this book can still be read upon its cover:
BThe Powers Below
BInside the book is a listing of unpronounceable names with foreboding titles, methods of worship, and preferred sacrifices...many of which include living, humanoid creatures.
BOn the inside cover of the book are the words: "Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms, The Forlorn Cavern, Ironforge. Proprietor: Gerrig Bonegrip."
BIf Bonegrip sells books like this, perhaps he'll buy this one back.
completion: Ah, a copy of The Powers Below. An interesting text, this is. And some might find it useful...
BBut this one's in sad shape. And look here! There are notes in the margin of almost every page!
BHm...I know this copy. I sold it to Bolgar last year. Are you...a friend of his? Yes, I thought you were. You have that same fire behind your eyes!
BWell, by definition, a friend of Bolgar's is a friend of mine. And we take care of our own, yes?

992.name: Gadgetzan Water Survey
desc: Use the untapped dowsing widget near the pool of water by Sandsorrow Watch. Once you have collected the sample, return the tapped dowsing widget to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan.
objectives: Use the untapped dowsing widget near the pool of water by Sandsorrow Watch. Once you have collected the sample, return the tapped dowsing widget to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan.
details: We've got a position open for a temporary junior-grade surveyor in the Gadgetzan Water Company, if you're interested!
BWith the nomads seizing all our wells, we need to exploit more free sources of water! There is water to be had in the desert, but only to those smart enough to survey them first.
BTake this dowsing widget and tap a sample of the water by the pool near Sandsorrow Watch. It's right in sight of the trolls around there. Bring the tapped widget back to me when you're done!
completion: What's this? You were ambushed by some sort of bad mojo creepy-crawly? Oh, this does not bode well for the Gadgetzan Water Company, no indeed...

BI guess I should have told you about the reports coming in on some crazy bug-creatures that appear to be sucking up all the water in the desert. At first, I thought it was just a crock. We have enough trouble with the nomads as is; I thought it was just more of their shenanigans. Well, now we know at least!

1016.name: Elemental Bracers
desc: Collect 5 Intact Elemental Bracers and use the Divining Scroll on them. Afterwards, bring the Divined Scroll to Sentinel Velene Starstrike at the Silverwind Refuge.
objectives: Collect 5 Intact Elemental Bracers and use the Divining Scroll on them. Afterwards, bring the Divined Scroll to Sentinel Velene Starstrike at the Silverwind Refuge.
details: Take this divining scroll--it can determine the creator of these elementals. But you will need something from them to use as a reagent to focus scroll's magic--their bracers should do nicely.

BA few intact bracers from the creatures should be enough. The other bracers will be useless for our purposes, but they may be worth something to a merchant if you wish to sell them. Once you have the intact bracers attempt to use the scroll. Return to me with the results and we shall proceed from there.
completion: Well done, $N, this should give us the information we need to have the culprit discovered. How would you feel about taking out the mage who fills our pools with corrupt elementals? The corruption of Ashenvale and beyond makes my stomach turn on its own--to have a wizard actively attempting to destroy it further sickens me to no end. We shall make him pay.

1040.name: Passage to Booty Bay
desc: Take a boat to Booty Bay and speak with Caravaneer Ruzzgot.
objectives: Take a boat to Booty Bay and speak with Caravaneer Ruzzgot.
details: Ah yes, finally found it. Should have told me she passed through here that long ago. Let's see.
BVelinde. Booked passage to Booty Bay on the Black Osprey. I don't have anything here saying otherwise, so I'd assume it arrived in port safely.

BNot much more help I can be to you, but she asked about overland travel over on that side of the world, and I mentioned Ruzzgot, a caravan driver based out of Booty Bay. Might be that this Velinde traveled with him.
BMove along, now. I haven't all day for you.
completion: Yes? Now, it doesn't look to me like you're the sort with goods that need shipping, so either you're looking for a job with my caravan--and there's no jobs to be had now--or you're probably talking to the wrong goblin.
BSo which one is it?

1064.name: Forsaken Aid
desc: Speak with Apothecary Zamah in the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Speak with Apothecary Zamah in the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff.
details: The tauren have a bond with the land, and it pains me to hear of Stonetalon's plight. But I fear that to heal the land, we must first remove the disease upon it.
BIs it not fortunate, then, that the Forsaken are allied with us? They know much of disease. I believe they can aid us, and by doing so they will strengthen the trust between our people.
BSpeak with Apothecary Zamah. She is a scholar and an emissary of the Forsaken. You will find her in the Pools of Vision below the Spirit Rise.
completion: Magatha sent word of your coming, $N. Although my heart beats no longer, I still feel sorrow for the spirits of Stonetalon.
BThe Forsaken are eager to offer what help we can.

1088.name: Ordanus
desc: Bring Ordanus' head to Braelyn Firehand near Sun Rock Retreat.
objectives: Bring Ordanus' head to Braelyn Firehand near Sun Rock Retreat.
details: They thought that they could halt the flow of magic. They were mistaken. They thought that they could hide Ordanus, but I will have his head!

BMagic grants me true sight. Yes... there he is. A crossroads... At the top of a great tree in Ashenvale Forest. A name... Raynewood. One of the eldest sons of the forest god. They spirited him away from the peak before I could find him, but his time runs short.
BBring it to me and I will share with you a mighty gift.
completion: I knew Ordanus once, long ago. He had the arrogance of his kind, holding himself above even the Highborne.
BHis head does not rise so high now, does it, $N?
BI promised you a reward, and you shall have it. Attend to me.

1112.name: Parts for Kravel
desc: Bring Kravel's Parts to Kravel Koalbeard in the Shimmering Flats.
objectives: Bring Kravel's Parts to Kravel Koalbeard in the Shimmering Flats.
details: Here's Kravel's package, $N. And when you deliver it, tell him... if he wants more special orders, then he'll have to pay his tab!
completion: Great, you got them! Now we need to get them to the gnomes. But first...
BLet's take out one small item...

1136.name: Frostmaw
desc: Bring Frostmaw's Mane to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Bring Frostmaw's Mane to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
details: $N, it is now time for you to travel to far-off lands. You are ready.
BYou now hunt Frostmaw, a yeti in the Alterac Mountains. He is elusive, his white coat blending into the snows of his mountain home. He rarely shows himself.
BBut I will show you how to entice a creature such as he. Here, take this scroll. On it I have written how Frostmaw may be lured.
BNow go, $N. Your journey is long and many challenges lay waiting. When you return with Frostmaw's mane, only then is your task complete.
completion: Both strength and cunning were needed to find and defeat Frostmaw, $N. You have both.
BYour path has taken you to the valleys of Thousand Needles and to the high mountains of Alterac. It will one day lead you through all the Earthmother's lands, for such is the way of the hunter.

1160.name: Test of Lore
desc: Find The Beginnings of the Undead Threat, and return it to Parqual Fintallas in Undercity.
objectives: Find The Beginnings of the Undead Threat, and return it to Parqual Fintallas in Undercity.
details: I will tell you what you must seek, and I will even ask you my question, but not because you wish to prove yourself. Knowledge is far more important than strength. Even as others seem to pass you by in ability, your knowledge of the world will be more valuable.

BGo to the Monastery in the north of Tirisfal Glades. In the library there, a book called Beginnings of the Undead Threat resides. It was used by the now-corrupt paladins there to train them to fight my kind.
BBring it to me.
completion: This is the book I sent you to search for.
B<Parqual slowly caresses his hand over the top of the book as he stares down at it.>

BSo now you wish a question to prove your mind is as powerful as your body and spirit. If you have studied the book long enough, then I shall ask you your question and you can be done with these tests!

1184.name: Parts of the Swarm
desc: Return to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Return to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.
details: Head back to Belgrom in Orgrimmar and tell him Moktar be doing his bidding well out in the Thousand Needles. Tell him also, that me studies progress, and I hope to be havin' learned more soon. That should please him greatly.
completion: I'm appreciative of your efforts, $c. The warchief will enjoy hearing how tenacious you have been in your duties.
BOh, of course I will mention your name to him. He speaks to me often and values my opinions greatly.
BGo now, I have much to do. And if you speak to Korran soon, and he has news of these creatures, then return to me--I would think they are a threat that must be taken seriously.

1424.name: Pool of Tears
desc: Fel'zerul in Stonard wants you to gather 10 Atal'ai Artifacts.
objectives: Fel'zerul in Stonard wants you to gather 10 Atal'ai Artifacts.
details: The Warchief sent us to investigate strange happenings at The Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
BThe Atal'ai trolls are a tribe of dark casters, known for practicing forbidden magic. You can imagine how astonished we were when we arrived here to discover the temple had been sunk.
BThe green dragons now guard the site, claiming to be protectors of Azeroth.
BWe need to discover what happened. Explore around the Pool of Tears and gather Atal'ai artifacts. From those I can begin to piece together this puzzle.
completion: Your diligence in collecting the Atal'ai artifacts is worthy of praise, $C.

1448.name: In Search of The Temple
desc: Brohann Caskbelly in Stormwind wants you to search for the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
objectives: Brohann Caskbelly in Stormwind wants you to search for the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
details: There was a time when I was young and full of vigor like you, $c.
BBut now I'm old and unable to explore the world like I once did. Ah, the things I saw!
BBut there was one mystery that eluded me. For my final quest, the Explorers' League sent me in search of The Temple of Atal'Hakkar. It was rumored to be located in the Swamp of Sorrows.
BBecause of my frail state, I traveled the skies by gryphon in search of it but never found it.
BHelp an old dwarf out? Perhaps you will have better luck on foot.
completion: The Temple of Atal'Hakkar has been sunk beneath the Pool of Tears? And surrounded by the green dragonflight?
BAn amazing discovery, $C. But obviously something has gone terribly wrong.

1472.name: Devourer of Souls
desc: Speak with Godrick Farsan in the Temple of the Damned.
objectives: Speak with Godrick Farsan in the Temple of the Damned.
details: A succubus is a devourer of souls, destroyer of hearts, tempter of men. A creature of profound evil and of singular mind.
BIt cannot be brought into our world without a stimulus.

BThus we use its own strength against it. With the hearts of good men, pure men, loving men, the succubus will be unable to resist, and will cross into our world. Then you can dominate it, and make it your own.
BSpeak with my assistant, Godrick Farsan, within the Temple. He will help you find your bait.
completion: You were sent by Carendin? $N, then.$b$bDo not think light of me because my sight is gone. I see things that lie behind now, with clarity I had never known. What I once thought a curse, is now a boon.

1520.name: Call of Earth
desc: Find Kodo Rock and drink the Earth Sapta.
objectives: Find Kodo Rock and drink the Earth Sapta.
details: A sapta is a drink created to bind our spirits to the elements. Fused with magic, the potion will allow the open minded to see the elements as no one has seen them before. Your spirit will forever be tied to the element the sapta was created for, and only a select few of our kind know the secrets of its creation.
BThe sapta is always imbibed in a holy place, and never anywhere else.
BSeek out the shaman shrine to the east of here and drink of the sapta.
completion: Ah... $N... pleased is the earth to have you here.
BBound together in body and spirit, you will go forward knowing that the mountains are your strength; the plains, your patience; and the world itself your essence.

BStanding before the earth humbly is all that is required of you for you to pass this rite. But the others are not as passive. They may be chaotic and often violent, but such is the nature of the elements. Dual natures opposing one another, you must come to learn these things intricately.

1640.name: Beat Bartleby
desc: Beat Bartleby, then talk to him.
objectives: Beat Bartleby, then talk to him.
details: You want what?? You're crazy!
BThe only way you'll get this mug is if you pry it from my cold, dead fingers...
completion: You're a lot tougher than you look!

1688.name: Surena Caledon
desc: Retrieve Surena's Choker for Gakin the Darkbinder in Stormwind.
objectives: Retrieve Surena's Choker for Gakin the Darkbinder in Stormwind.
details: I had a student named Surena Caledon. She stood where you stand now, eager to learn of warlock magic, and possessing no small bit of talent. More than that she was young and pleasing to the eye. Had I seen it then, the traitorous trollop!
BThe thieving wench ran off with one of the Defias, Erlan Drudgemoor. While her loss is of little importance, I gifted her a bloodstone choker that I must have.
BHer life means nothing to me now. You will find her at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch. Retrieve what is mine.
completion: Surena was talented, but not enough so to gain mastery of warlock magic on her own. It's a shame to see talent wasted, but sometimes it is necessary.
BI hope my investment in you will bear different results.

1712.name: Cyclonian
desc: Bring the items on Bath'rah's Parchment to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac.
objectives: Bring the items on Bath'rah's Parchment to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac.
details: I have spent ages watching this site. I watch, so that one day I might see the great Cyclonian fall. But I have not yet found a champion to defeat the wind lord.
BPerhaps you are that champion.
BProve it to me. Gather the items I need to summon Cyclonian, and I will know you are a great warrior. Perhaps then you can defeat him and gain his whirlwind heart.
BIf so, then I will infuse the heart's power in a weapon, and I will give that weapon to you.
BHere is a parchment with the items I need.
completion: You have gathered the items for my spell, and have shown me your strength and cunning. But the next stage of our quest is even more perilous.
BLet us hope your strength does not falter.

1784.name: The Tome of Divinity
desc: Retrieve a Dark Iron Script from the Dark Iron dwarves near Helm's Bed, and return to Muiredon Battleforge in Ironforge.
objectives: Retrieve a Dark Iron Script from the Dark Iron dwarves near Helm's Bed, and return to Muiredon Battleforge in Ironforge.
details: Before I fell in battle, Muiredon and I had almost defeated one of the Dark Iron spies near that small house. We witnessed their captain passing orders to them, and sought to kill him and take the orders.

BSome of the council in Ironforge do not yet believe the presence of Dark Iron dwarves exists in Dun Morogh. By attaining one of those scripts, we'll not only have proof of their movements, but possibly an idea of what they're planning.
BGet one of those scripts and take it back to Muiredon, $N.
completion: Haha! You've done it! Ya saved Narm, and ya found the proof me wife needs to take to the council. Yer a blessin' o' the Light if I ever saw one... not includin' me wife o' course.
BThank ya again, $N.

1880.name: Mage-tastic Gizmonitor
desc: Bring Bink her Mage-tastic Gizmonitor.
objectives: Bring Bink her Mage-tastic Gizmonitor.
details: We mages do more than just waggle our fingers and make pretty sparks! We control magic, the base fabric of our world! And that takes great care, and resolve. And knowledge... so much knowledge!

BOne of my devices, the mage-tastic gizmonitor, collects and stores that knowledge in huge amounts! But it's lost! When we fled our home of Gnomeregan, I left it in a chest in one of our huts outside the city, and now the place is crawling with leper gnomes!
BPlease, $N, retrieve my gizmonitor!
completion: Oh, splendid day! When I made the gizmonitor I never realized how dependent on it I would become. Now I can begin my studies anew!
BThank you, $n! And here--these were my first tools as a mage. They're a little scratched but they're well tested. Take your pick--I'm sure you'll find either of them useful.

1952.name: Mage's Wand
desc: Speak with Tabetha after her ritual.
objectives: Speak with Tabetha after her ritual.
details: I'll go make the wands now.
completion: Here are the wands I made. Take your pick!

2240.name: The Hidden Chamber
desc: Read Baelog's Journal, explore the hidden chamber, then report to Prospector Stormpike.
objectives: Read Baelog's Journal, explore the hidden chamber, then report to Prospector Stormpike.
details: Now for the task at hand.
BThere is a secret chamber, the Chamber of Khaz'mul, that must be explored. The problem is that the chamber's behind a huge, locked door! It's a lucky thing I know how to open it.
BI've described everything in my journal, here on the table. My band and I are stuck here for now... so you, $N, must find the chamber of Khaz'mul for us!
BRead my journal, explore the chamber, then report to Prospector Stormpike at the Explorers' League in Ironforge.
completion: You have seen the Chamber of Khaz'mul? Amazing! Baelog was sure it existed, but I must admit that I had my doubts.

BThank you, $N. With luck your finding will incite our leaders to renew their efforts to retake Uldaman. And if it is ever again under Ironforge control, then the secrets of the Chamber of Khaz'mul will be ours!

2360.name: Mathias and the Defias
desc: Travel to Westfall and find Agent Kearnen for your debriefing.
objectives: Travel to Westfall and find Agent Kearnen for your debriefing.
details: Not a moment too soon, $N. SI:7 reconnaissance is reporting unusually heavy Defias activity in Westfall.

BIt would seem that the Defias have taken over an abandoned Alliance watch tower southeast of Sentinel Hill and are using it as a base of operations to smuggle in goods from the Redridge supply route.
BGet to Westfall and contact Agent Kearnen for your debriefing. You will find her hidden near the tower.
B...and $N, should you be discovered, SI:7 will disavow all knowledge of your existence.
completion: Mathias finally sent another agent to back me up, eh? Well I hope he's ready to hear some bad news.

2480.name: Hinott's Assistance
desc: Wait for Serge Hinott to complete the cure.
objectives: Wait for Serge Hinott to complete the cure.
details: I have never seen such wondrous results from a poison! Zanzil you say? Never heard of him, however, I must commend him on the creation of this concoction.
BSo, I am to cure you of this and then teach you how to make use of the poison?
BGive me a few moments to examine the toxin, $N.
completion: The cure is ready! Drink this anti-toxin and the creeping madness will stop, however, I will not be able to do anything about the smell.

2744.name: The Demon Hunter
desc: Speak with Loramus Thalipedes in Azshara.
objectives: Speak with Loramus Thalipedes in Azshara.
details: The triad is protected by Razelikh.

BIn exchange for their servitude, Razelikh granted each of them nearly unlimited power within the Blasted Lands. The amulet pieces are each attuned to the lifeforce of their owner, granting them immortality. As long as they remain within the Blasted Lands, they cannot be slain, their life spans extended until the end of days.
BThere is one who may be able to assist you further, $N. Travel to Azshara and find the demon hunter, Loramus Thalipedes. Search the islands.
completion: I will help you. Although, I do not think you fully understand what you are up against.

2768.name: Divino-matic Rod
desc: Bring the Divino-matic Rod to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.
objectives: Bring the Divino-matic Rod to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.
details: Sergeant Bly stole from me! He said he'd only borrow it, but he stole my cherished divino-matic rod!! Without that rod how will I know where to dig new water holes??
BFind Bly and bring me my rod! I heard he led his band of ill-reputed adventurers to go treasure hunting in Zul'Farrak to the west. I bet you'll find him there.
BLet's hope the trolls took care of him, because if you have to fight him for the rod then you're in for a serious fight.
completion: You found it! Well done, $N! Did you have to fight Bly for it? I hope you knocked him and his band down good and hard!

2864.name: Tran'rek
desc: Speak with Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.
objectives: Speak with Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.
details: My cousin Tran'rek is in a tight spot. He promised me a load of scarab shells weeks ago and he hasn't delivered. He's my cousin, so I'd hate to have to send someone to Gadgetzan to break something on him.
BCan you speak to Tran'rek for me? Let him know he needs to get that delivery together before I do something rash?
BGadgetzan is in northern Tanaris, in Kalimdor.
completion: Hello!
BOh, you spoke to my cousin Krazek? How is he? I hope Booty Bay is treating him well...
BScarab shells, you say? Well... let me tell you a story...

2936.name: The Spider God
desc: Read from the Tablet of Theka to learn the name of the Witherbark spider god, then return to Master Gadrin.
objectives: Read from the Tablet of Theka to learn the name of the Witherbark spider god, then return to Master Gadrin.
details: The Witherbarks worship a spider god, and from her they collect their most potent venom. So if you want the venom, then you must summon their god!
BTo do that, you must know her true name, and that name is on a tablet buried in Tanaris, in the troll city of Zul'Farrak, in a tomb guarded by Theka the Martyr.
BDefeat Theka and find and read his tablet to discover the spider god's name. When you know it, return to me.
completion: Ah, Elortha no Shadra... speak this name only in whispers, for its utterance carries much weight in the realms of the spirit.
BI will put it to parchment and create for you a spell of summoning...

2984.name: Call of Fire
desc: Find Kranal Fiss in the Barrens.
objectives: Find Kranal Fiss in the Barrens.
details: Long has it been since you were last tested, $N. You have shown patience thus far in your studies, but the time has come for you to learn more. The time has come for you to learn about destruction... and chaos. The element of fire is yours for the understanding, if you're prepared to pay for it.
BSeek out Kranal Fiss in the Barrens. He lives in a small dwelling north of the Crossroads, but be mindful, if you've reached the night elf lands, you've gone too far.
completion: Hmmm, Narm sent you to me, did he?$BbWell then, Narm could always be trusted, so that must mean you're ready to take part of the next sapta--the sapta of fire.

BI see it in your eyes already, the burning, the desire. You've tasted power, and now you're ready for more of it. Patience, $n. Remember what earth taught you. Power and destruction will come easily, but you must still know when to stay your hand.

3104.name: Glyphic Letter
desc: Read the Glyphic Letter and speak to Khelden Bremen inside Northshire Abbey.
objectives: Read the Glyphic Letter and speak to Khelden Bremen inside Northshire Abbey.
details: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $N. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Khelden, our local mage trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
completion: Haha, I knew my note would not dissuade you from your path. So, you're prepared then, are you? Prepared to accept your fate? Prepared to challenge the gods and any other forces that stand before you in the pursuit of knowledge and power?
BI will not lie, $N, you will be feared as much as respected. But also know this, I will be here for you when you need training. Simply seek me out as you grow more powerful.

3128.name: Natural Materials
desc: Bring 2 Splintered Logs, 6 Encrusted Minerals, 20 pieces of Resilient Sinew, and 40 Metallic Fragments to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Camp Mojache.
objectives: Bring 2 Splintered Logs, 6 Encrusted Minerals, 20 pieces of Resilient Sinew, and 40 Metallic Fragments to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Camp Mojache.
details: I will need certain materials to complete my endeavor... You may do this alongside the other tasks I will give you.

BI'll need a splintered log from a treant of Feralas. Encrusted minerals, these can be found on the mountain giants and faerie dragons to the west. Also, find me some resilient sinew from the owlbeasts of the Hinterlands or hippogryphs of Feralas. Finally, I'll need a large amount of metallic fragments from any of these creatures I mentioned.
completion: Excellent! These materials, combined with the muisek, should yield just the results we've been wanting.

3368.name: Suntara Stones
desc: Take the Singed Letter to Thorius in Ironforge. He is in the Hall of Explorers.
objectives: Take the Singed Letter to Thorius in Ironforge. He is in the Hall of Explorers.
details: Brother,
BIf you are reading this letter, I am no more. How it got to you, I do not know, but thank and reward the ones responsible.

BAbout the stones: They exist and the Dark Irons have them in their possession. Their leader, Lathoric the Black, is using the power of the stones to enslave my excavation team. They were taken to the cauldron. Their minds are twisted, working night and day to complete something called Obsidion.
BHelp them, brother. It is the final wish of a dead man.
B-Dorius$B
completion: <Thorius wipes his face dry.>
BIn the name of the Light, he will have his wish. This I vow.

3512.name: In Eranikus' Own Words
desc: Travel to the eastern part of Winterspring and speak with Umbranse the Spiritspeaker.
objectives: Travel to the eastern part of Winterspring and speak with Umbranse the Spiritspeaker.
details: $N, our first step will be to devise a method to speak with Eranikus through the gem. He lies in a precarious state between sleep and death now, twisted within a weave of nightmares. Though the essence you have given me is badly tainted, there is a chance we can reach him.

BTravel far to the icy lands of eastern Winterspring and seek one of our mortal allies, Umbranse the Spiritspeaker. He is a human medium who speaks for the dead. Though Eranikus is not truly dead, he may be of aid to us still.
completion: Itharius was wise to send you to me. While he is not dead as you understand death, Eranikus will soon give us advice in his own words. For now though, I cannot directly help you... at least not yet.

BI will lend my skill at death-speaking to you, but first I need the help of one who - unlike me - is not limited by the frailties of old age. My most potent augury device has been taken from me against my will, and unless I have it back we will be at a loss to help Eranikus.

3632.name: Gnome Engineering
desc: If you wish to learn more about Gnome Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge.
objectives: If you wish to learn more about Gnome Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge.
details: Engineering at the expert level breaks into two disciplines: gnome and goblin. Gnome engineering represents by far the superior of the two! It's about the construction of wonderful gadgets and devices that make life better!

B$N, read this manual. If you want to learn more on gnome engineering, then take that manual to Tinkmaster Overspark here in Ironforge. Remember - membership is permanent and prevents joining the other discipline, so make sure you are sure before finishing his task!
completion: Ah, a young engineer interested in pursuing the one, true discipline of engineering! Well forgive my melodrama, friend. While our situation remains dire, it still is always a good day to see another engineer respond to the clarion call of true engineering!

3824.name: Gor'tesh the Brute Lord
desc: Find Gor'tesh, somewhere to the west of Dreadmaul Rock. Kill Gor'tesh and then take Gor'tesh's Lopped Off Head back to Oralius in Burning Steppes.
objectives: Find Gor'tesh, somewhere to the west of Dreadmaul Rock. Kill Gor'tesh and then take Gor'tesh's Lopped Off Head back to Oralius in Burning Steppes.$B
details: They're reeling I tell you! Our next strike must be decisive.
BThe brute lord, Gor'tesh, must be slain. More importantly, his head must be returned to me so that I may prepare the third phase of our attack on the Firegut ogres.
BBe warned, soldier, Gor'tesh rules not from Dreadmaul Rock but from a Blackrock orc structure to the west of Dreadmaul Rock.
BYour orders, then, are simple. Find Gor'tesh and chop off his fat head. Return to me when the job is done.
BSHUT UP, WINKY!
completion: Just look at it, soldier. Disgusting! When the remaining Firegut ogres see this fat mug stuck on a pike sitting at the top of their mountain, mass hysteria will ensue!
B<Oralius cackles wildly.>

4136.name: Ribbly Screwspigot
desc: Bring Ribbly's Head to Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.
objectives: Bring Ribbly's Head to Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.
details: My brother Ribbly has always been a drain to his family, taking our money and wasting it on one scheme after another.

BWell, his last scheme must have been his worst, because Baron Revilgaz of Booty Bay just put a price on poor Ribbly's head. I can't tell you how happy this makes the Screwspigots! Our little Ribbly's finally worth something!
BBut now he's hiding out, deep in Blackrock Depths. Please, find him and bring him to me!
BOr, if he won't come, then that's ok... just bring me his head.
completion: Aha! You found him! And... it appears that my little brother didn't want to come quiety. It's a pity. I would have liked to see the look on his face when I told him our plans to turn him in to Revilgaz.
BThank you, $N. You've made my family very happy. And Ribbly's never looked as peaceful as he does now.

4184.name: The True Masters
desc: Travel to Stormwind and deliver Solomon's Plea to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon.
Bolvar resides in Stormwind Keep.
objectives: Travel to Stormwind and deliver Solomon's Plea to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon.
BBolvar resides in Stormwind Keep.
details: This is grim news, $N. To discover that our mortal enemies are merely pawns of a much greater threat is disheartening. There is no possible way that Lakeshire could survive an attack from both the Blackrock orcs and the black dragonflight. Should Lakeshire fall to this menace, Darkshire would fall next, and then what? Goldshire? Stormwind itself?
BYou must take this information to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind at once! If this does not merit the aid of Stormwind, nothing will and all is lost.$B
completion: Dragons? Impossible!

4496.name: Bungle in the Jungle
desc: Bring a Gorishi Scent Gland and 5 Un'Goro Soil samples to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.
objectives: Bring a Gorishi Scent Gland and 5 Un'Goro Soil samples to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.
details: My research revealed to me that the silithid are like bees; destroy the queen of the hive, and the rest of should be thrown into disarray. I'll brew a lure that we'll use to bring out the queen; once summoned, you'll take her down.

BFirst though, we need some reagents; we don't want you bungling into the jungle unprepared. Go west to find the silithid hive in Un'Goro Crater and obtain a scent gland from one of the bugs. I'll also need some samples of the native Un'Goro soil.
completion: The scent gland, ah yes. The membrane appears intact - excellent. The soil, yes, this should work out perfectly. With my special additions, I should be able to grind all this up into the perfect lure.
BGive me a moment to make the lure, $N. Once it's ready, we'll be able to enact the next step that may hopefully stop the silithid before they overrun Gadgetzan... and the rest of Kalimdor.

4736.name: In Search of Menara Voidrender
desc: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.
objectives: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.
details: Ah, hello, $N. You're progressing well in your training. So well in fact that I think you should be rewarded for your hard work--and for not becoming corrupted by the arcane yet.
BIf you're interested, seek out Menara Voidrender in Ratchet. She is currently staying at Strahad Farsan's tower overlooking the town.
BShe's not very friendly, $N, so don't expect any praise. But if you work hard, she'll make sure you're taken care of.
completion: Ah, Briarthorn sent you. Good. Then word does reach far enough to find future students. This pleases me.

BIt is typical of our kind, $N, to band together, regardless of race. It is especially important since those we deal with most do not discriminate in their malice if we fail to appease them or control them properly.
BI feel you've learned a great many things, and if you are willing, I would help you create tools to compliment your skills.

4784.name: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
desc: Bring some Fine Gold Thread, 2 Smoldering Coals, and a Soul Shard to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.
objectives: Bring some Fine Gold Thread, 2 Smoldering Coals, and a Soul Shard to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.
details: I need only three things now, $N, then we can finish your robe.
BFirst, the fine gold thread Xizk is making for you. Return to him in Booty Bay and get it.
BSecond, bring me two smoldering coals from the fire elementals in the Arathi Highlands. If I recall correctly, they are to the west, near Thoradin's Wall.
BFinally, a soul shard created by you.
BAfter you have all the components, return here to the tower and I will complete the robe for you.
completion: Excellent, $N! The components are gathered and we are ready.
BI trust you will be pleased.

4808.name: Felnok Steelspring
desc: Give Tinkee's Letter to Felnok Steelspring.
objectives: Give Tinkee's Letter to Felnok Steelspring.
details: I have another favor to ask of you.

BMy initial study of the essence you collected shows that it might be possible to freeze dragon whelp eggs and preserve them! I want to test this theory, but first I need specially made engineering components. My colleague, Felnok Steelspring, can make them.
BHere, take this letter to Felnok. It tells him what I need. You'll find Felnok in Winterspring, in the town of Everlook.
completion: That's no blanket! But what have we here? I letter from Tinkee? I wonder what she has to say...

BAh, she's studying in the Burning Steppes. That makes sense--that's a good source for dragonkin. Oh, but look! It says here that she needs some parts for a device she wants to build. I guess that's where I come in, eh?

4904.name: Free at Last
desc: Escort Lakota Windsong from the Darkcloud Pinnacle, and then talk to Thalia Amberhide at Freewind Post.
objectives: Escort Lakota Windsong from the Darkcloud Pinnacle, and then talk to Thalia Amberhide at Freewind Post.
details: Arnak thinks we're going to be married... but after I declined his offer he came back that night and kidnapped me. My brother tried to stop him, but Arnak was too strong. He... he slew my brother and then brought me here. My poor brother...
B$N, could you escort me out of the Darkcloud Pinnacle? Please... I need to get back to Thalia! She must be worried sick about me.
completion: Thank you, $N. Deep in my bones I knew that she would find her way back to me. She told me of your bravery and how you helped her escape. These items belonged to her brother. I know she would want you to have them.

4976.name: Returning the Cleansed Orb
desc: Return the Cleansed Infernal Orb to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.
objectives: Return the Cleansed Infernal Orb to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.
details: Take the cleansed orb back to Menara in Ratchet, $N. Give her my regards and be safe. I truly hope you are able to withstand the temptation and corruption that is sure to come as you follow your path.
BGood luck.
completion: Well done, $N. This will do nicely.
BThe only thing left for you to do is to decide on which demon you want me to imprison within the cleansed orb. Do that, and you will have a magnificent new item to wield.

5048.name: Good Natured Emma
desc: Find Ol' Emma in Stormwind and see if she is in fact Emma Felstone. If she is, then perhaps she'd like the package Janice Felstone made for her.
objectives: Find Ol' Emma in Stormwind and see if she is in fact Emma Felstone. If she is, then perhaps she'd like the package Janice Felstone made for her.
details: She's a tad ornery, and quite possibly out of her gourd... but the records indicate that Ol' Emma does fit the framework of who Emma Felstone might be.
BPerhaps you've seen Ol' Emma wander the city - she talks to herself, most often in nonsensical jibber-jabber. Still, she doesn't hurt anything or anyone, so folks pretty much leave her be.
BAll things considered, I would say that Ol' Emma is in fact Emma Felstone. You might try asking if her last name is indeed Felstone.
completion: My name is indeed Emma Felstone - you're the first person in years to call me that. Who... who are you?

BYou say you knew... my sister?! Is she still alive? Who am I kidding, of course she isn't. When the plague broke out in Lordaeron, I had come to expect the worst. So many of my family died... or worse. Here I am now, crazy Ol' Emma, all alone. What are you, a grave-robber or something? Looking for your next target?
BWhat... you have a package for me from my sister?

5096.name: Scarlet Diversions
desc: Proceed to the Scarlet Crusade's base camp between Felstone Field and Dalson's Tears and destroy their command tent.
Place the Scourge banner at the camp, and then return to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
objectives: Proceed to the Scarlet Crusade's base camp between Felstone Field and Dalson's Tears and destroy their command tent.
BPlace the Scourge banner at the camp, and then return to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
details: Before Andorhal, we must tackle the advancing Scarlet Crusade menace from Hearthglen. They've made camp between Felstone Field and Dalson's Tears, making us risk conflict against both the Scourge and the Crusade at once.

BMy plan is to play them off of each other by sending you to destroy the command tent they've set up; use some Flame in a Bottle from this box of incendiaries. Once razed, plant this Scourge banner by the tent. With some luck, they'll ignore us and focus on the Scourge for vengeance.
completion: Finely executed, $N. Your attack on the Scarlet Crusade will buy us time. I have sent one of my best scouts out to watch over the camp and make sure that the Crusade forces that come to reinforce the position will take the bait.

BWith the pressure on us lessened, we should now finally be able to risk a mission into Andorhal itself, and an important one at that. I'd very much like it if you'd perform this one as well, based on your success to date.

5144.name: Elemental Leatherworking
desc: Bring 2 Heart of Fire, 2 Globe of Water, 2 Core of Earth, and 2 Breath of Wind to Sarah Tanner in Searing Gorge.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Elemental Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.
objectives: Bring 2 Heart of Fire, 2 Globe of Water, 2 Core of Earth, and 2 Breath of Wind to Sarah Tanner in Searing Gorge.
BCompleting this quest will give you access to the Elemental Leatherworking arts.
BThe completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.
details: Elemental leatherworking is what I know, and if you're willing to open your mind to the greater powers of substance, I will share with you all there is to learn.

BKnow this, $c: by choosing this path you agree never to learn dragonscale or tribal leatherworking; there is only room for practice of one of the three arts. Furthermore, I'll need adequate proof that you are in tune with the elements of nature; to that end, bring me the purest essences of fire, water, earth, and wind.
completion: You've cast your lot, and the elements accept you. Once I have finished my tutelage, you shall command the will to craft the finest of leather garbs.
BTo train in the art for the future, simply speak to me and I will make available any knowledge that you have yet to commit as yours.

5168.name: Heroes of Darrowshire
desc: Bring Davil's Libram and Redpath's Shield to Carlin Redpath.
objectives: Bring Davil's Libram and Redpath's Shield to Carlin Redpath.
details: The heroes of Darrowshire hold a place in my heart, and the book you brought me, the Annals of Darrowshire, tells their tales.
BIt tells of the paladin Davil Lightfire and how the Crusade took his libram to the town hall of Hearthglen.
BIts passages also speak of my brother, Captain Redpath. After his betrayal, his shield was cracked and discarded and now lies in the most unlikely of places -- near the barn of Gahrron's Withering.
BGather these relics, $N. For fate and tragedy surrounds them.
completion: You have the libram and the shield!
BTheir history is entwined with the history of Darrowshire, and somehow, I know that fate will bring them together again.

5216.name: Target: Felstone Field
desc: Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there. It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
objectives: Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there. It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
details: Of the four cauldrons here in the west, the one located at Felstone Field may be the easiest one in obtaining access to. The Scourge have greener troops positioned here, though they should not be underestimated.

BGo to Felstone Field, northwest of Andorhal, and engage the cauldron lord there. We think it has a key that will unlock access to the cauldron. When unlocked, use this bottle to obtain a sample of the poisons inside the cauldron; we'll need it for study in developing a counter agent.
completion: The key taken from Cauldron Lord Bilemaw is a perfect fit in unlocking the access panel. A foul stench emanates from the opened panel as an unknown mix of concentrated substances swirl inside the cauldron.
BThere is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for High Priestess MacDonnell back at Chillwind Point.

5264.name: Lord Maxwell Tyrosus
desc: Speak with Lord Maxwell Tyrosus. He is inside the church.
objectives: Speak with Lord Maxwell Tyrosus. He is inside the church.
details: I am about to bestow a great honor upon you, $N.
BLord Maxwell wishes to reward you for your service to the Argent Dawn!
BIt has been years since Maxwell has granted audience to outsiders.$B
completion: You are a worthy ally, $N. You shall reap the rewards of your stalwart dedication.

5384.name: Kirtonos the Herald
desc: Return to the Scholomance with the Blood of Innocents. Find the porch and place the Blood of Innocents in the brazier. Kirtonos will come to feast upon your soul.
Fight valiantly, do not give an inch! Destroy Kirtonos and return to Eva Sarkhoff.
objectives: Return to the Scholomance with the Blood of Innocents. Find the porch and place the Blood of Innocents in the brazier. Kirtonos will come to feast upon your soul.
BFight valiantly, do not give an inch! Destroy Kirtonos and return to Eva Sarkhoff.$B
details: This is it, $N.
B<Eva points to the vial inside the bag.>
BThe blood of innocents. The purest blood, used to appease Krastinov's master.
BIt is with this blood that Kirtonos may be summoned. It is with this blood, then, that Kirtonos must be destroyed.
BTake the blood to the porch. Place it upon the brazier. Kirtonos will come - he cannot resist. When he appears, unleash the fury and wrath of a thousand innocent deaths upon him.
BShould you succeed, you will earn more than just our gratitude.
completion: With the death of Kirtonos, a chapter in the horrible tale of Scholomance comes to a close. There is, however, more to be done. Others here are now aware of your brave acts. Take this, $N. It is a piece of our own essence. It will allow you to communicate with the other lost souls of Caer Darrow.

5504.name: Mantles of the Dawn
