desc: Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Hasana at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
objectives: Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Hasana at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
details: Your service to the Argent Dawn is to be commended, $N. You are truly revered amongst us. I have been authorized to make available for you to purchase one of the Dawn's most valued items - our magic resistance mantles.

BApplication of a mantle to your existing shoulder piece will enhance your resistance to the powers of magic in one of five potential ways. As a sign of continued dedication to our cause, I ask for no less than ten of our valor tokens in exchange for access to these mantles.
completion: Outstanding - your tribute to the Dawn is duly noted, $N. With this accomplished, I am delighted to make our mantles available to you for purchase. So long as you maintain your current status with us, these mantles will be purchasable from any authorized quartermaster of the Argent Dawn.
BFor the Dawn, my $Gbrother:sister;!

5528.name: The Gordok Taste Test
completion: You da big boss now, so you get free sample of my better brews! These drinks boost you up AND give you good buzz! These are da good ones, chief... you try and tell Kreeg yourself!

5624.name: Garments of the Light
desc: Find Guard Roberts and heal his wounds using Lesser Heal (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant him Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Priestess Josetta in Goldshire.
objectives: Find Guard Roberts and heal his wounds using Lesser Heal (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant him Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Priestess Josetta in Goldshire.
details: Normally I put forth a small challenge to followers of the Light to test their skill. I want to see if they are worthy of wearing their first robes--a sign that the church outwardly approves of the $gpriest:priestess; and supports $ghim:her;.

BBut this situation is a bit different. One of Goldshire's citizens saw an injured guard near the lake to the east of here. His name is Roberts. Find him, heal him, fortify his body and return here. If you can do that for me, then I will consider your test complete.
completion: Excellent, $N. With one more healthy guard out there to help the town, we'll be that much safer. I'm glad to see you're already learning to use your abilities wisely. If you feel you are ready for more training at any time, please come back to me. But for now, take this robe. It will let others know that you are one of our order. If you don't want to wear it, that's fine. Later there will be more tests and this robe isn't necessary for those.

5648.name: Garments of Spirituality
desc: Find Grunt Kor'ja and heal her wounds using Lesser Heal (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant her Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Tai'jin at Razor Hill.
objectives: Find Grunt Kor'ja and heal her wounds using Lesser Heal (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant her Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Tai'jin at Razor Hill.
details: You be ready for your first test, $N. South of Razor Hill, just outta town, one of our grunts be hurt fightin' off some o' Proudmoore's old troops. She not doin' too well, an' she benefit much if one of our kind could help her. Find her--her name be Kor'ja--heal her wounds, an' give her the blessin' of our ancestors.
BYou do this, an' me thinks that be sufficient proof that you ready to move on in our ways.
completion: Good, then Kor'ja lives and goes off to defend our town from those malicious humans. I often wish to remember days of battle; where power was shown in combat and it was the wise who often destroyed those who relied on just their strength.
BYou done good by me, $N. You take this robe now. Maybe it help, maybe you not care, but you earned it and I'm proud to call you brother.

5672.name: Elune's Grace
desc: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
objectives: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
details: A wonderful day has come, $N. You've reached the age in which our <priests or priestesses> are trained in abilities only Night elves know. But it is not for me to train you. You must return to the Temple of the Moon and speak to Priestess Alathea as soon as your business here is concluded. She will test you to ensure you're prepared, and only then will she teach you Elune's Grace.
completion: By devoting yourself to Elune and our people, you have attained a state that not all of us can achieve. It is tradition that you then be taught even greater abilities for your devotion. Do you accept?

5888.name: Salve via Mining
completion: Very well then, here's some Cenarion plant salve. If you find more vitriol when you mine in Felwood, remember to hold on to it for me! The more of it you find, the more salve I will be able to make.

6032.name: Sacred Cloth
desc: Bring 2 Mooncloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.
objectives: Bring 2 Mooncloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.
details: Although the people of Timbermaw delight in the feel of runecloth, it is not sacred to us. But mooncloth is sacred.
BBring me a small supply of this holy cloth, and I will teach you a secret fashioning technique.
completion: Ah, very good. This mooncloth will be used for garments sacred to our people. Thank you, $N. Now I will train you.

6128.name: Gathering the Cure
desc: Bring 5 Earthroot and 5 Kodo Horns to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads so he may make a curative salve.
objectives: Bring 5 Earthroot and 5 Kodo Horns to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads so he may make a curative salve.
details: The water will serve as the base of the curative salve I shall make for the gazelles. For curative properties, I need some earthroot. Herbalists know how to find it, so if you are not familiar with this skill you'll need to find one to help us out.

BFinally for potency, I need kodo horns - mere chips and fragments will not suffice. Kodos you can handle wander the northern part of the Barrens; bring some down for the greater good of the balance $N, and fetch the horns for me.
completion: This is good, $N, so much so that it should be enough to make some ample doses of the salve - at least enough to start to make a difference.

BMaking a cure for poisons can be quite difficult at times because each one often requires a very specific antidote to counteract it. Imagine being able to cure a poison at will without having to worry about the exact ingredients of what the antidote must be!
BNow, let me get to work on this!

6344.name: Nessa Shadowsong
desc: Speak with Nessa Shadowsong.
objectives: Speak with Nessa Shadowsong.
details: A friend of mine, Nessa Shadowsong, is a fishing merchant in Rut'theran Village. She needs a parcel taken to Darkshore, and is looking for someone to help her.
BIf you're interested, then to reach Nessa you must take the portal in Darnassus to Rut'theran Village. You will find the portal west of the Temple Gardens.
completion: Yes, I have need of a courier who will take a package to Darkshore. Will you help me?

6392.name: Return to Brock
desc: Buy a gryphon to Thelsamar from the gryphon master Gryth Thurden, then bring the Honorary Picks to Brock Stoneseeker in Thelsamar.
objectives: Buy a gryphon to Thelsamar from the gryphon master Gryth Thurden, then bring the Honorary Picks to Brock Stoneseeker in Thelsamar.
details: For a small fee you can buy a gryphon ride to Thelsamar... as long as you've already been there. Gryphons will only fly you to places you've already been, so be sure to speak with every gryphon master you see so you can fly to him later.
BYou've already been to Thorgrum, the gryphon master of Thelsamar, so now you can return to him. And once in Thelsamar, you can deliver the picks to Brock Stoneseeker.
BSpeak with me when you're ready to go.
completion: You brought the picks. Great! I'll get these to my mining students. I'm sure they're eager to use them on the ore deposits of Loch Modan.
BThank you for your help, $N. I am in your debt, but I hope this money will at least cover your travel costs.

6584.name: The Test of Skulls, Chronalis
desc: Guarding the Caverns of Time in the Tanaris Desert is Chronalis, child of Nozdormu. Destroy him and return his skull to Emberstrife.
objectives: Guarding the Caverns of Time in the Tanaris Desert is Chronalis, child of Nozdormu. Destroy him and return his skull to Emberstrife.
details: The time watchers, children of Nozdormu - Lord of the Centuriesss...
BIt is three that guard the Caverns of Time, but only one that holds the interests of the Black Flight: The Time Shifter, Chronalis, favored drakeling of Nozdormu.
BSsstrike at this champion, a blow to make even the stoic sands of time weep. Return to me with his skull.
completion: The most hated remainsss...

6608.name: You Too Good.
desc: You think Lumak is trying to tell you that he can no longer help you improve your fishing skill. You may want to try to find his friend, Nat Pagle, a human fishing off one of the islands south of Theramore (at least that's what you think Lumak said).
objectives: You think Lumak is trying to tell you that he can no longer help you improve your fishing skill. You may want to try to find his friend, Nat Pagle, a human fishing off one of the islands south of Theramore (at least that's what you think Lumak said).
details: Lumak no can teach $N no more. You too good! Find Lumak friend, Nat Pagle. Is human but no eat! Is Lumak friend! Nat teach you fish gooder.
BYou find Nat in Dustwallow Marsh, south of Humie town, Thermorosomethinglikedat. Nat probably fishing. Go now!
completion: 'Course, you must be a friend of Lumak's.
BFishin'? I can tell you all 'bout fishin'.

6824.name: Hands of the Enemy
desc: Bring the Hands of Lucifron, Sulfuron, Gehennas and Shazzrah to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.
objectives: Bring the Hands of Lucifron, Sulfuron, Gehennas and Shazzrah to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.
details: $N, your service is of great value to us, so we are reluctant to send you on this last mission for we do not want to lose such a useful agent.
BBut its success would further our war efforts tremendously and... it was deemed worth risking you.
BWe want these captains in the Molten Core destroyed: Lucifron, Sulfuron, Gehennas and Shazzrah. Kill them and bring me their hands!
BThis task will take every resource you possess, $N, but if you can do it then the Firelords will be dealt a terrible blow.
completion: You have the hands! You defeated the fire captains! I would not have thought it possible, had I not known you and what you are capable of.
B$N, your exploits are without number, but word of this last feat will send waves among the Waterlords. Your name may one day be legend to us.
BSpeak with me again, $N. I may have yet another task...

6848.name: Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye
desc: Recover Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye from the Winterax caves and return it to Master Ryson.
Be warned, it is said that Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye carries with it a terrible curse!

7064.name: Corruption of Earth and Seed
desc: Slay Princess Theradras and return to Selendra near Shadowprey Village in Desolace.
objectives: Slay Princess Theradras and return to Selendra near Shadowprey Village in Desolace.
details: Deep in Maraudon lives an evil creature of chaos--Princess Theradras is an elemental force of earth related to the Old Gods. Ages ago, she and Zaetar, first son of Cenarius, began a relationship. The offspring of their time together became known to the people of Kalimdor as centaur. Ever-thankful creatures, the centaur killed Zaetar, and now hold Zaetar's remains. My quest here is to find those powerful enough to slay Theradras so we may recover Zaetar's remains before returning to Stonetalon.
completion: This is most wonderful news, $N! Thank you!
BI will speak with Marandis and ask his wisdom on the topic of Zaetar's remains, but at least you have overcome the hardest of the tasks.
BI was told that if we were successful in our mission, I had permission to reward those who aided us. I was given these items as tokens from our people--you may choose one.

7496.name: Celebrating Good Times
desc: Seek out Major Mattingly in the Valley of Heroes.
objectives: Seek out Major Mattingly in the Valley of Heroes.
details: Seek out Major Mattingly in the Valley of Heroes, $N. He will be expecting you...
completion: Few are graced with such ceremony, $N. Please, choose your reward so that we may begin the celebration.

7640.name: Exorcising Terrordale
desc: Use the Exorcism Censer to drive out the spirits that torment Terrordale. When you have slain 25 Terrordale Spirits, return to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.
objectives: Use the Exorcism Censer to drive out the spirits that torment Terrordale. When you have slain 25 Terrordale Spirits, return to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.
details: I have added a pinch of dirt from the tainted ground of Terrordale in the Eastern Plaguelands to the censer. You will now use this censer to find areas there that show signs of spiritual turmoil and disturbance. Look for green auras that permeate the ground as the physical world buckles under the torment of the spirit realm and use the censer to drive out the evil spirits.
BWhen you have passed sufficient judgment on the spirits there, you will be ready to proceed.
completion: Well done, $N. To render the judgment of the Light on those that dwell in darkness is a task we must approach with vim and zeal; you have done just that with your sacrifice in Ironforge and your judgments of the spirits in Terrordale.
BYour next steps will call on both sacrifice and judgment again as you now strive to reclaim the spirit of a fallen charger who now serves a Death Knight known as Darkreaver.

7736.name: Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Kingsblood
desc: Deliver 2 Incendosaur Scales, 4 Kingsblood and one Coal to Master Smith Burninate.

7784.name: The Lord of Blackrock
desc: Speak with High Overlord Saurfang in Orgrimmar. He stands waiting for you in the Valley of Strength.
objectives: Speak with High Overlord Saurfang in Orgrimmar. He stands waiting for you in the Valley of Strength.
details: Seek out High Overlord Saurfang in the Valley of Strength.
completion: Choose your reward so that I may mount the head of the beast for all to see.

7808.name: A Donation of Silk
completion: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, $N!

7928.name: Darkmoon Warlords Deck
desc: Return the Warlords Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.

8048.name: The Hero's Brand
completion: Vigilance, honor, loyalty, bravery... You embody all of these traits and so shall your brand.

8072.name: Paragons of Power: The Madcap's Mantle
desc: Bring Falthir the Sightless a Primal Hakkari Girdle. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
Falthir the Sightless is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
objectives: Bring Falthir the Sightless a Primal Hakkari Girdle. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
BFalthir the Sightless is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
details: One of Zandalar's legendary madcaps was Khar'vaxal the Cracked. Legend states that when facing the enemies of the tribe for the first time, Kar'xavan used his mantle specifically woven with "the weave of madness". His form was shrouded not only by the mantle, but also with the blinding speed of his twin daggers. Madcaps today cherish their mantle as a sign of their place in the tribe.
BBring to me the Paragons of Power I seek, and such a mantle will be yours to weave madness unto your own enemies.
completion: Victory is ours this day, thanks to the madness you have sowed upon our mutual enemies! You are to be honored amongst the Zandalar, and there is no better way of showing gratitude for your deeds than by offering you the madcap's mantle!

8120.name: The Battle for Arathi Basin!
desc: Assault the Arathi Basin mine, lumber mill, blacksmith and stable, and then return to Deathmaster Dwire in Hammerfall.
objectives: Assault the Arathi Basin mine, lumber mill, blacksmith and stable, and then return to Deathmaster Dwire in Hammerfall.
details: As you no doubt have heard, the League of Arathor is sending large numbers of troops into Arathi Basin. Eager for food and supplies, these Alliance fools are intent to take and control the rich resources there. We must show them that Arathi will never again be a home for humans!
BGo to Arathi Basin and assault the mine, the lumber mill, the blacksmith and the stables. Pull down the enemies' banners, declaring those territories for the Horde.
BGo, $N. Report back to me when this task is complete.
completion: NULL

8144.name: Zandalarian Shadow Mastery Talisman
completion: This is the last time we will speak under the auspices of Shera Ali'kh. You know all that you must. Take the talisman and continue in your slaying. Hakkar must never be allowed to leave Zul'Gurub.

8168.name: The Battle for Arathi Basin!
desc: Assault the mine, the lumber mill, the blacksmith and the farm, then return to Field Marshal Oslight in Refuge Pointe.
objectives: Assault the mine, the lumber mill, the blacksmith and the farm, then return to Field Marshal Oslight in Refuge Pointe.
details: $N, the battle for Arathi Basin is a battle for resources and territory. Key points in the area must be held and operated in order to supply our forces with much needed raw materials and supplies. I charge you to assault the points farthest from our Arathi Basin base.
BAssault the farm, the mine, the lumber mill and the blacksmith when they are controlled by the enemy. Find the enemy's banner and rip it from its flag post!
BWhen you have done this to all four points, return to me.
completion: NULL

8192.name: Animist's Caress
desc: Bring me thise things and I will create a powerful enchantment for you!
Primal Hakkari Idol
Punctured Voodoo Doll

8240.name: A Bijou for Zanza
desc: Destroy any one of the Hakkari Bijous found in Zul'Gurub at the Altar of Zanza on Yojamba Isle. When done, speak with Vinchaxa nearby.
objectives: Destroy any one of the Hakkari Bijous found in Zul'Gurub at the Altar of Zanza on Yojamba Isle. When done, speak with Vinchaxa nearby.
details: The destruction of the various Hakkari Bijous is of grave importance to us, so much so that we welcome outsiders of the tribe to do so for themselves!

BTake any one of the bijous that you find in Zul'Gurub to the Altar of Zanza and destroy it. For this one time alone, I will give you an additional Honor Token from our tribe; this is above and beyond what you would normally receive.
BWitness for yourself the blessings of Zanza!
completion: Excellent... each bijou we wrest away from the Blood God's minions is one step closer we all are to finally defeating them once and for all. You bring honor to the Zandalar - and yourself - through your noble actions.

BRemember $N, you may always destroy the bijous you find in Zul'Gurub at the altar. For each one, you will gain recognition and an Honor Token! Just remember to have an open space in your inventory if you don't have one of the tokens already.

8264.name: Defiler's Standard Care Package
completion: You've certainly begun to prove yourself to us, $N. As a reward, please take this care package! Inside it you'll find rations and bandages that are usable only inside Arathi Basin.

BAs you continue to prove yourself inside the Basin, you'll find that these items will become available to you for purchase. Rations become available when you are Honored with us, and bandages when you are Revered.

8288.name: Only One May Rise
desc: Return the Head of the Broodlord Lashlayer to Baristolth of the Shifting Sands at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
objectives: Return the Head of the Broodlord Lashlayer to Baristolth of the Shifting Sands at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
details: There is no time to waste! A hero must be found! The task I give will require an army to complete but only one may rise from the throng of would be champions to take on the burden and responsibility of an ally of the Brood.

BWithin the lair of the Lord of Blackrock is a most cruel beast. The Broodlord Lashlayer guards the Halls of Strife, blocking the way into Nefarian's inner sanctum. Slay the foul aberration and return his head to me. Do this and you may begin the next step of your journey.
completion: Could you be the first to earn favor among the Bronze Flight in a thousand years?

8312.name: Hallow's End Treats for Spoops!
desc: Speak with the innkeepers of Orgrimmar, Undercity, and Thunder Bluff, as well as Kali Remik in Sen'jin Village. Perform the tricks they ask of you in exchange for the treats they offer.
Return to Spoops at the Orgrimmar Orphanage with a Thunder Bluff Marzipan, Darkspear Gumdrop, Orgrimmar Nougat, and Undercity Mint.
objectives: Speak with the innkeepers of Orgrimmar, Undercity, and Thunder Bluff, as well as Kali Remik in Sen'jin Village. Perform the tricks they ask of you in exchange for the treats they offer.
BReturn to Spoops at the Orgrimmar Orphanage with a Thunder Bluff Marzipan, Darkspear Gumdrop, Orgrimmar Nougat, and Undercity Mint.
details: I want to go trick-or-treating, but I can't because I'm sick. If you go for me, I'd trade you the candy you get for some I already have! I think you'd like this candy - it makes you turn into things both funny and scary!

BEach of the innkeepers in the big cities have candy they give for Hallow's End - talk to them and do the tricks they ask for! Also, a troll named Kali Remik in Sen'jin Village is handing out candy as well. When you have all the candy, bring them back to me here!
completion: Wow, you got them all! You're awesome!
BThank you for trick-or-treating for me. Here, take these pumpkin treats - I think you'll like them a lot!
BHappy Hallow's End, $N!

8360.name: Dancing for Marzipan
desc: Do a dance emote at Innkeeper Pala, and in exchange you'll receive Thunder Bluff Marzipan!

8384.name: Claiming Arathi Basin
desc: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.

8408.name: Fight for Warsong Gulch
desc: Bring 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.

8432.name: Battle of Warsong Gulch
desc: Bring 3 Warsong Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

8504.name: The Alliance Needs More Stranglekelp!
desc: Bring 20 stranglekelp to Private Draxlegauge at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8528.name: The Alliance Needs Spotted Yellowtail!
desc: Bring 20 Spotted Yellowtail to Huntress Swiftriver at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
objectives: Bring 20 Spotted Yellowtail to Huntress Swiftriver at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
details: It may not seem heroic to gather up cooked fish, but do not underestimate the value of preparation, young $c. Soldiers need to eat like anyone else, and we're here to do our part to make sure they have what they need once the war in Ahn'Qiraj commences.

BAccordingly, I am stockpiling spotted yellowtail, a versatile source of sustenance that stores well and can be used in many different dishes. It also doesn't have the odor of some other saltwater fish. Are you willing to aid me in this endeavor?
completion: Thank you for this gift, $C, and in such a timely manner as well. Our soldiers will surely not lack for something to eat. Just let me get these fish stored away properly and then you and I can discuss a second haul if you're willing.

8552.name: The Monogrammed Sash
desc: Return the Monogrammed Sash to its owner.
objectives: Return the Monogrammed Sash to its owner.
details: This fine sash has the letters "HS" embroidered along its hem.
completion: You recovered my sash? Then... you must have killed Mok'rash the sea giant! Hooray!
BI'm glad the scurvy villain's dead - Mok'rash was one of three sea giants who smashed my ships and killed my crew.
BThree times.
BYou are a $C of worth, $N.

8576.name: Translating the Ledger
completion: First things first, $N! We need to figure out what Azuregos wrote in this ledger.
BYou say that he's told you to make an arcanite buoy and that this is the schematic? Strange that he would write this in Draconic. That old goat knows I can't read this nonsense.
BIf this is going to work, I'm going to need my scrying goggles, a five hundred pound chicken and volume II of "Draconic for Dummies." Not necessarily in that order.

8600.name: The Horde Needs Rugged Leather!
desc: Bring 10 Rugged Leather to Doctor Serratus at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring 10 Rugged Leather to Doctor Serratus at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
details: I find that the fit of the knife in your palm is more important than the edge on it. Even the dullest blade can be made to cut if pressure is being properly applied through it, wouldn't you agree, $c? But you and I don't have such problems as we maintain the sharpest of edges, yes?

BWell, no matter, I have a task for you. In service to the Horde, and to do your part for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort, I want you to return to me with a number of rugged leather skins. This is something that you will do, no?
completion: Very well, it appears you've done a fairly decent job of it, though some of those skins look a bit ragged about the edges. No matter, the task is completed, and you have earned your reward. Should you come across another stack of rugged leather, be sure to bring them to me posthaste.

8624.name: Stormcaller's Leggings
desc: Bring the Skin of the Great Sandworm, 2 Idols of Strife, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Kandrostrasz inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

8648.name: Darkcore the Elder
completion: It is good to know the people of this land still pay homage to the olden races. I bid you well, $N, and offer you this token...

8672.name: Stonespire the Elder
completion: Your spirit burns with life, young $C. I accept the homage you pay, and offer in return this token...

8696.name: Cloak of the Unseen Path
desc: Bring 1 Qiraji Regal Drape, 2 Lambent Idols, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in Silithus. You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Regal Drape, 2 Lambent Idols, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in Silithus. You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
details: I'm glad to hear you're aiding us in our attack on Ahn'Qiraj, $N. I can make you a protective item that'll be of assistance in the fight against our enemy, $c.
BI shall need a Qiraji drape, which I'll resize for you of course. I'll also need idols and scarabs which I'll use to create a suitable clasp.
BI promise you won't be disappointed.
completion: Ah yes... this drape is immaculate.
BTake this cloak, $N. May it protect you from the foul magic of the Qiraji.

8720.name: Skygleam the Elder
completion: The heavens, in their countless stars, hold answers to earthly mysteries, $N. Might, then, the wise, and the lucky, gaze up and find truth?

8744.name: A Carefully Wrapped Present
completion: The tag on this present reads:$b$bTo $N,$b$bMay your feast of Great-Winter be merry and bright!

8768.name: A Gaily Wrapped Present
completion: This festively-wrapped present has your name on it.$b$bWait, did it just move?

8792.name: The Horde Needs Your Help!
desc: Speak with Warlord Gorchuk in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.
objectives: Speak with Warlord Gorchuk in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.
details: Hello, I'm glad that you've decided to hear me out. The Horde needs all of the help that it can get to prepare for the Ahn'Qiraj War, and that means that we need you! Even now as we speak, official collectors are gathering the necessary material needed for the upcoming war, but we won't be able to meet our goals without your assistance, $N!
BYou should go speak with the guy in charge, Warlord Gorchuk. What do you say, $c? Will you help out with the vital preparations?
completion: Throm'ka, $c! Good to see so many of the Horde, such as yourself, $n, coming out to lend your support in laying the groundwork for the upcoming Ahn'Qiraj War. The effort here will ensure that we are victorious against the Silithid and their evil masters hidden away inside Ahn'Qiraj.
BSo now that you are here, be sure to speak with the various collectors and offer your assistance in gathering those materials that you are suited to.

8912.name: An Earnest Proposition
desc: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Bracers of Valor to Deliana in Ironforge.
objectives: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Bracers of Valor to Deliana in Ironforge.
details: Well met, $c. I've something that might interest you.

BI have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality. I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor.

BThe blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment. Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold. You shall find the effort worth your while.$B
completion: Excellent! Let's perform the trade then. It's hard to part with this excellent armor, but I'm afraid I won't be needing it any time soon.
BIf you're interested in performing more work for me, I might be willing to give up the rest of the pieces.

8936.name: Just Compensation
desc: Bring a Dreadmist Belt and a set of Dreadmist Wraps to Deliana in Ironforge.
objectives: Bring a Dreadmist Belt and a set of Dreadmist Wraps to Deliana in Ironforge.
details: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux. I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin. Bring me the belt and set of gloves that you wish to upgrade. I promise the ones I give you in return will be far superior.
completion: You've kept your end of the bargain, I shall keep mine.
BJust remember that I'm holding on to the best pieces until your work is finished.

8960.name: Bodley's Unfortunate Fate
desc: Travel to Blackrock Mountain and use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer to find Bodley near Blackrock Spire.
objectives: Travel to Blackrock Mountain and use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer to find Bodley near Blackrock Spire.
details: So we need to recover the rest of the medallion? Finding Bodley's going to be a bit of a headache. He went back to Blackrock Mountain to attempt to re-enter Blackrock Spire and never came back.
BI'd suggest taking the goblin's ghost revealing device with you, as I fear the worst might have happened.
completion: I am so glad that you can see me. Finally someone to talk to!

BWill you help us, $N? Help to undo the wrong that we perpetrated and put things to right? If it's true that you already have the Top Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet, then I think I can point you in the right direction to acquire the other two parts, reunite them and put an end to all of this.
BOh, by the way, hello, my name is Bodley. Nice to meet you!

8984.name: The Source Revealed
desc: Find Apothecary Staffron Lerent in the Hillsbrad Foothills past Ravenholdt Manor.
objectives: Find Apothecary Staffron Lerent in the Hillsbrad Foothills past Ravenholdt Manor.
details: Look, the actions of a rogue apothecary are not my concern. If he's undermining our efforts, then let me be the first to point you in the right direction
BIf he's innocent, then he's got nothing to hide, right?
BI purchased the goods from Apothecary Staffron Lerent. He's working in a secluded area past Ravenholdt Manor in the hills over Hillsbrad. To be honest with you, I thought he was a little odd.
completion: Yes, I made those fragrances. Wonderful smell, isn't it? Irresistible.
BOnce the warriors of Alliance and Horde alike are smitten with these feelings of love, they will be powerless to stop the rise of the Shadow Council.
BThey will be weakened, unprepared. As they worry for their loved ones, they will lose their edge.
BThe solution was so simple. Why did it take me so long to come upon it? The weakness of all is through the heart. And there is nothing you can do to stop the inevitable.

9008.name: Saving the Best for Last
desc: Give Mokvar your Beaststalker's Cap and Beaststalker's Tunic.
objectives: Give Mokvar your Beaststalker's Cap and Beaststalker's Tunic.
details: A truly amazing story, $N! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved, I can assure you. Through your efforts we are delivered from the mistakes of our past.
BAs to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you have definitely earned and will truly enjoy.
completion: I will truly miss you, $N. There is a debt that I owe you, which I may never be able to repay.
BEnjoy your new head and chest armor. May it protect you for a long time to come, and help you to achieve even greater honor!

9032.name: Bodley's Unfortunate Fate
desc: Travel to Blackrock Mountain and use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer to find Bodley near Blackrock Spire.
objectives: Travel to Blackrock Mountain and use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer to find Bodley near Blackrock Spire.
details: The medallion contained Valthalak's soul? It's no surprise it was guarded by such a powerful curse.
BLocating Bodley presents a bit of a problem. Last time I heard of him, he was preparing to venture back into Blackrock Spire. He was never heard of again.
BSeek him out in Blackrock Mountain, though I'm afraid to say he's probably dead by now. I suggest taking the goblin's device with you, friend.
completion: I am so glad that you can see me. Finally someone to talk to!

BWill you help us, $N? Help to undo the wrong that we perpetrated and put things to right? If it's true that you already have the Top Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet, then I think I can point you in the right direction to acquire the other two parts, reunite them and put an end to all of this.
BOh, by the way, hello, my name is Bodley. Nice to meet you!

9056.name: Cryptstalker Headpiece
desc: Huntsman Leopold at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Cryptstalker Headpiece if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Headpiece, 15 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 4 Arcanite Bars and 2 Nexus Crystals.

9080.name: Bonescythe Pauldrons
desc: Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Bonescythe Pauldrons if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Pauldrons, 12 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 5 Cured Rugged Hides, 1 Nexus Crystal and 50 gold pieces.

9104.name: Plagueheart Leggings
desc: Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Plagueheart Leggings if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Leggings, 20 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 4 Mooncloth and 2 Nexus Crystals.

9128.name: The Elemental Equation
desc: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Core of Elements.
objectives: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Core of Elements.$B
details: Greetings, adventurer! Are you interested in some work? I pay those under my employ with insignias. These insignias can be used at the Quartermaster to purchase items of power.
BAll I need you to do is bring me as many core of elements as you can carry. The more the better!
BYou'll find them on elementals of varying shapes and sizes that exist across our world.
completion: A job well done, $N! As promised, the INsignia is yours. Just remember, there's more WHERE that came from...

9200.name: Craftsman's Writ - Major Mana Potion
desc: Deliver 10 Major Mana Potions and the Craftsman's Writ - Major Mana Potion - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

9224.name: Epic Armaments of Battle - Honored Amongst the Dawn
desc: For 75 Insignias of the Dawn and 75 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.

9248.name: A Humble Offering
desc: Aurel Goldleaf at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to bring her 1 Abyssal Scepter. You must also be Honored with the Cenarion Circle.
objectives: Aurel Goldleaf at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to bring her 1 Abyssal Scepter. You must also be Honored with the Cenarion Circle.
details: Ishnu-alah, $r. Show me proof of the demise of a Lord of the Abyssal Council and I shall reward you with an item that should aid you in your battles against the Qiraji.
completion: Ande'thoras-ethil. It means; 'May your troubles be diminished,' in my native tongue.
BWear the band proudly and in good health, $N.

9272.name: Dressing the Part
completion: Yarrr... if ye be keen on enjoying the company of us experienced sea dogs, you'd best belay dressing like a blaggard! Here, put on something proper 'fore I keelhaul yer hide.
BThese'll fit ye better than they ever fit that old dog, Red-Eyed Ben. Lost him in a devil of a storm at sea.
BWear 'em with pride, mate!

9368.name: The Festival of Fire
desc: Touch the bonfires within Orgrimmar, Thunder Bluff, and the Undercity, then speak to a Festival Talespinner within the capital cities.
objectives: Touch the bonfires within Orgrimmar, Thunder Bluff, and the Undercity, then speak to a Festival Talespinner within the capital cities.
details: Midsummer is upon us once again!

BEach year, as tradition dictates, Flamekeepers are chosen to tend the bonfires within our capitals. While fires are burning throughout Azeroth, it is imperative that ours be the hottest and brightest, to properly pay homage to the season.
BIn fact, I have a task for you, if you don't mind. I've not yet heard if the fires in all capitals are properly burning. Travel there yourself and warm yourself by the fires--make sure they're hot!
completion: Excellent work, $N. With the shadows destroyed, it can only be a matter of time before the Lich King decides to recall his necropolises and leave us in peace.

9416.name: Report to General Kirika
desc: Speak with General Kirika at the Horde encampment near Hive'Regal.
objectives: Speak with General Kirika at the Horde encampment near Hive'Regal.
details: You must be one of General Kirika's new recruits. It's about time you showed up. Bodies wear down quick in the desert.
BThe dwarves have been getting reinforcements daily, and we can't afford to lose ground in our struggle for resources in Silithus.
BGet your instructions from the General. It's not my job to train you, just find you.
completion: It's good that you're here, but there's no time to waste making small talk. You need instructions, and then you need to get out there.
BListen up.

objectives: Find the Frightened Paladin in Deathknell.
*Offer aid to the Frightened Paladin
details: Not all of our fellow Paladins who rise again are quick to acclimate to our new reality. Some struggle to reconcile that they are now, in a way, the very thing they spent their lives fighting against.

These individuals often simply need a kind gesture and a sympathetic ear. Unfortunately, many others are quick to turn violent. Find the frightened paladin who fled into the hills directly west of this chapel. Extend a hand in friendship. Lead them back into the light if you can.

objectives: Report to the Image of Archmage Modera near the City of Dalaran.
details: I bring ill tidings from Dalaran. Something has disrupted our ley lines, causing erratic and destructive behavior from our constructs in the city.

We know not yet what is causing this mayhem. The high council has ordered us to keep this matter private so as to not bring shame to our order. But we cannot keep up this charade forever. The city is being overrun as we speak!
Archmage Modera has dispatched me to solicit outside aid. Seek her image out near Dalaran beside Lordamere Lake.

objectives: Collect a Fel Infused Blossom from the City of Dalaran for Shylamiir in Stormwind City.
* Fel Infused Blossom
details: If you're going to bother me you can at least make yourself useful. I have an errand I need run.
For a city of mages, Dalaran has a surprising interest in botany. The Kirin Tor keep to themselves, but I would love a sample of their mana-infused vegetation.
You're clearly someone who is comfortable being where people don't want you, maybe you could find a way into the city. If you do, bring me back whatever is growing in their central garden.

objectives: Alba Fairmoon wants you to collect 7 Longshore Murloc Gills along the shoreline of .
*Longshore Murloc Gill (7)
details: The corruption affecting Westfall's crops may have seeped into the ocean as well. If the local fish are affected too, it could doom Stormwind to famine.

Collect gills from the murlocs along the shoreline and bring them to me. Murlocs are quite hardy, but their physiology is extremely sensitive to contaminants. Any toxins in the seawater will be readily apparent in the gills you find.

objectives: Acquire the Dalaran Sewer Key for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
* Grimy Key
details: The Alliance had an army of mages known as the Kirin Tor. While they were powerful, the demonic Burning Legion proved to be even more so. In one fell swoop, the arch demon Archimonde flattened their city like it was a child's plaything. Those who remained were reduced to merely dispossessed vagabonds.
That is, until they rebuilt Dalaran. And on the Dark Lady's very doorstep, no less!
While in their camps, search for something that can get us into the city unnoticed. I must know more.

objectives: Collect the Highly Toxic Strain from Witherfang in Ruins of Lordaeron for Theodore Griffs in Undercity.
*Highly Toxic Strain
details: Welcome to the most vital organ of the Undercity: The Apothecarium! Here we experiment on the most virulent of Azeroth's exotic specimens.

You've caught me in a good mood, so I will let you in on my latest investigation. It appears there is a particularly venomous arthropod stalking the ruins above our fair city. Its toxins are said to eat through even undead flesh. How exhilarating!
I wish to validate these claims. Should you find yourself withering away from its bite, I should love a sample.

96392.name: Farsen's Watch
details: Greetings to ye, friend. My name is Earthseer Farsen and I'm visiting Dun Morogh from Aerie Peak. As I was travelin', I couldn't help but notice that we have, well... a bit o' a Dark Iron Dwarf problem.
If ye have a moment, I can show ye what I mean. I've got a bit o' magic that should do the trick.
objectives: Speak with Earthseer Farsen and ask him to lend you his farsight to observe the Dark Iron threat.
*Use Farsen's Farsight
completion: So ye see now, <class>? Thick as cockroaches they are, and that's just the ones we can see from the sky.
Ye look like a sturdy enough sort. Hows about a bit o' violence?

objectives: Speak to Eleanor Shackleton near Brill.
details: , you have proven yourself trustworthy in your endeavors against the Scarlet Crusade so far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.
I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Brill. Go and see what she's doing.

objectives: Observe the conversation between Danitha Morr and Leonid Barthalomew the Revered.
details: Danitha and I fought against the scourge in the defense of the Undercity when Naxxramas attacked. We lost many good friends that day, including the hero after which this keep was named--Garek Bandarion.
He might just have been the first Forsaken to rediscover how to wield the light as a paladin. I am encouraged to see his legacy and potential live on here with Danitha and her cohort.
If only the rest of the forsaken felt the same way...

objectives: Read the Glyphic Parchment and speak with Mai'ah near the entrance to the Den in the Valley of Trials.
*Glyphic Parchment (Forever item) (provided)
details: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, .
Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the mage trainer Mai'ah. She would have words with you when you're ready.

99152.name: As Above, So Below
details: While the Tarnished in Shadowvale to the southwest are definitely a problem, we cannot allow the cellars below the town to fester into a full-blown Scourge uprising on Bandarion Keep.
I need to get these trainees up to snuff in case that happens. You, however, are going to receive what I like to call a crash course.
Travel beneath Shadowvale and retrieve some of their wretched bones so we can study them further. I need ones that still retain some of the initial reanimation magic--that's glowing ones.
objectives: Collect 6 Faintly Glowing Bones for Hilda the Breaker.
*Faintly Glowing Bone (6)
completion: Well done, recruit. We might just make something out of you yet.
With these bones we may be able to better understand how such a threat was able to go unnoticed for so long.
